Pet.Name: Mechanical Squirrel
Pet.Description: A mechanical squirrel's logic center tells it to collect and store both nuts and bolts for the winter.

Pet.Name: Bombay Cat
Pet.Description: Donni Anthania plans to have a bombay buried with her when she dies. A wise adventurer can put its talents to much better use.

Pet.Name: Cornish Rex Cat
Pet.Description: Donni Anthania invites these cats to her tea parties. But she doesn't serve their favorite drink: the tears of their enemies.

Pet.Name: Black Tabby Cat
Pet.Description: Old Alterac saying: 'A cat has nine lives, but needs only one.'

Pet.Name: Orange Tabby Cat
Pet.Description: The last person who tried to housebreak this cat quickly learned that a soiled rug is better than a shredded everything-else.

Pet.Name: Siamese Cat
Pet.Description: Known for its blue eyes. Also considered a delicacy by giant murlocs.

Pet.Name: Silver Tabby Cat
Pet.Description: Sleeping is this cat's second favorite activity. The first is yawning.

Pet.Name: White Kitten
Pet.Description: 'The queen had three kittens. The first gave her a juicy rat. The second, a tasty hare. And the white, her favorite, presented the head of her rival.'

Pet.Name: Cockatiel
Pet.Description: Some say this clever bird can be taught to speak--but it's smart enough to keep its beak shut.

Pet.Name: Hyacinth Macaw
Pet.Description: The jungle trolls train these birds to mimic calls for help in order to lure unsuspecting travelers into traps.

Pet.Name: Green Wing Macaw
Pet.Description: Favored pet of the Defias pirates, this colorful bird is handy for remembering passwords, grocery lists, and cracker recipes.

Pet.Name: Senegal
Pet.Description: Favored pet of the goblins of Booty Bay, this colorful bird is renowned for its ability to count coins, tally budgets, and lie about contracts.

Pet.Name: Ancona Chicken
Pet.Description: It thinks you taste like chicken too.

Pet.Name: Undercity Cockroach
Pet.Description: The cockroach is usually an impulse buy. Its owners have a hard time parting with it even after numerous attempts.

Pet.Name: Dark Whelpling
Pet.Description: Hopes that someday it can grow up to destroy villages, just like mommy.

Pet.Name: Azure Whelpling
Pet.Description: Like other members of the blue dragonflight, these whimsical little critters display an affinity to arcane magic.

Pet.Name: Crimson Whelpling
Pet.Description: Hailing from the Wetlands, this young dragon is just learning how to hunt, breathe fire, and go on cute destructive rampages.

Pet.Name: Emerald Whelpling
Pet.Description: Once bred and raised by the green dragon Itharius, this unique breed of dragon has settled in the jungles of Feralas.

Pet.Name: Wood Frog
Pet.Description: Vendors at the Darkmoon Faire offer strange and exotic wonders. They also sell wood frogs.

Pet.Name: Tree Frog
Pet.Description: Known for their powerful legs and keen eyesight.

Pet.Name: Hawk Owl
Pet.Description: This dark-feathered bird of prey is often seen as a harbinger of doom amongst the druids of Teldrassil.

Pet.Name: Great Horned Owl
Pet.Description: Night elf children are given an owl feather on their first birthday as a token of good luck.

Pet.Name: Brown Prairie Dog
Pet.Description: A complex system of burrows protects the prairie dog from its neighbors' massive hooves.

Pet.Name: Snowshoe Rabbit
Pet.Description: If you go chasing snowshoe rabbits, you know you're going to fall.

Pet.Name: Albino Snake
Pet.Description: A favored companion of Kirin Tor magi, this reptile makes one wonder whether it's truly a snake or something else altogether.

Pet.Name: Black Kingsnake
Pet.Description: Xan'tish fearlessly tracks, captures, and trains these noble snakes so they will aid their comrades in battle.

Pet.Name: Brown Snake
Pet.Description: The brown snake is native to Horde-controlled territories. It seems unremarkable until its victims are within range.

Pet.Name: Crimson Snake
Pet.Description: The crimson snake is favored among the Darkspear trolls for not only its vicious nature, but also its steadfast loyalty.

Pet.Name: Pet Bombling
Pet.Description: Possibly explosive, definitely adorable. Keep away from open flame.

Pet.Name: Lil' Smoky
Pet.Description: This tiny peacekeeper security bot is often outfitted with the latest arcane nullifiers and crowd pummelers. Not for the environmentally minded.

Pet.Name: Sprite Darter Hatchling
Pet.Description: These adorable critters love snuggling with their owners after a long day of brutal, bloody battle.

Pet.Name: Worg Pup
Pet.Description: Worgs are the favored companions of orcs and are fiercely loyal on the battlefield.

Pet.Name: Smolderweb Hatchling
Pet.Description: Although born in the warm heights of Blackrock Spire, the smolderweb hatchling can survive most environments.

Pet.Name: Lifelike Toad
Pet.Description: Talented engineers have crafted an exact replica of a wood frog, at only ten times the cost of buying the real thing.

Pet.Name: Disgusting Oozeling
Pet.Description: Warning: Wear gloves and goggles while handling disgusting oozeling. DO NOT WASH. Will stain most armor.

Pet.Name: Land Shark
Pet.Description: After birth, newborn sharks quickly flee their hungry mothers. Their early independence makes them dangerous, even while young.

Pet.Name: Tranquil Mechanical Yeti
Pet.Description: This clever toy is equipped with a secret switch to disable its 'tranquil' mode. Luckily, even the engineers who built it don't know how to find it.

Pet.Name: Tiny Snowman
Pet.Description: He loves to dance and wave and play with you! He melts after Winter Veil, but don't worry; he'll be back again someday!

Pet.Name: Winter Reindeer
Pet.Description: Would rather not spend any more time inside a wrapped holiday gift box.

Pet.Name: Father Winter's Helper
Pet.Description: These off-season allies work tirelessly to prepare for the Feast of Winter Veil, and would appreciate not being disturbed the rest of the year.

Pet.Name: Winter's Little Helper
Pet.Description: During the majestic Winter Veil celebration, these faithful companions spread joy throughout the land. The rest of the year, they are busy.

Pet.Name: Peddlefeet
Pet.Description: The power of love can be a dangerous thing, especially when wielded by an airborne, ill-tempered goblin.

Pet.Name: Speedy
Pet.Description: Slow and steady wins the race.

Pet.Name: Mr. Wiggles
Pet.Description: Many assume 'Wiggles' refers to the motion of this pig's posterior. They discover the true meaning when they see their own entrails.

Pet.Name: Whiskers the Rat
Pet.Description: A clever tactician, Whiskers will feign death to fool predators and bill collectors.

Pet.Name: Spirit of Summer
Pet.Description: This little piece of summer smells of warm evenings and lightning storms. If you look closely, you might be able to make out a face.

Pet.Name: Hippogryph Hatchling
Pet.Description: After a harpy incursion in Feralas, several hippogryph nesting grounds were attacked. Hundreds of hatchlings were orphaned, and they have been entrusted to the care of the druids on Sardor Isle.

Pet.Name: Magical Crawdad
Pet.Description: Only magical wishes make magical crawdads. If you wish for a fish, fish for a wish.

Pet.Name: Mana Wyrmling
Pet.Description: The ethereal Rashaad began breeding these enigmatic creatures after learning of their ability to feed on arcane energies.

Pet.Name: Brown Rabbit
Pet.Description: This bunny is the cutest thing its opponent will ever see. It'll also be the last.

Pet.Name: Blue Moth
Pet.Description: Delicate denizen of Azuremyst Isle, this magical insect has been rumored to possess healing abilities.

Pet.Name: Red Moth
Pet.Description: A product of exposure to wild magical energies, this insect is the unexpectedly colorful result of Azerothian moth species being released into the eco-domes of the Netherstorm.

Pet.Name: Yellow Moth
Pet.Description: Prefers flying during thunderstorms, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

Pet.Name: White Moth
Pet.Description: Prefers flying during foggy nights, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

Pet.Name: Golden Dragonhawk Hatchling
Pet.Description: Once prized by dragonhawk breeders in Silvermoon. Stands out at night to predators, making it necessary to gain awareness at an early age.

Pet.Name: Red Dragonhawk Hatchling
Pet.Description: Mortal enemies with silver dragonhawks; on pretty good terms with golden dragonhawks.

Pet.Name: Silver Dragonhawk Hatchling
Pet.Description: Ferocious species of dragonhawk, often seen diving down on prey from high in the sky.

Pet.Name: Blue Dragonhawk Hatchling
Pet.Description: Raised by the few dealers still willing to trade in Netherstorm.

Pet.Name: Firefly
Pet.Description: Commonly used by sporelings as a light source as they navigate the waterways of Zangarmarsh, this luminescent insect helps them avoid the dangerous bogflare needlers.

Pet.Name: Wolpertinger
Pet.Description: Many a drunken Brewfest goer has told the tale of this mysterious creature, but few remember that tale in the morning.

Pet.Name: Bananas
Pet.Description: Although loath to part with Bananas, Landro realized it would be safer if the pet was far from Booty Bay when his father, King Mukla, discovered he was missing.

Pet.Name: Willy
Pet.Description: He's slightly evil but extremely narcoleptic. Keep him away from critters!

Pet.Name: Egbert
Pet.Description: The sin'dorei use hawkstriders as mounts, but this little one was deemed unfit after being diagnosed with numerous anxiety disorders.

Pet.Name: Peanut
Pet.Description: Domesticated elekks are trained as mounts by the draenei people. In the wild they are hunted for their ivory tusks.

Pet.Name: Sinister Squashling
Pet.Description: This mischievous gourd likes to pop out of the ground and scare you right out of your pants. Hail to the pumpkin song!

Pet.Name: Toothy
Pet.Description: The crocolisk's hide and meat are prized by hunters, but the beast is ferocious and seldom taken by surprise.

Pet.Name: Muckbreath
Pet.Description: Muckbreath is just like other crocolisks, except he has an excellent sense of humor.

Pet.Name: Mojo
Pet.Description: Amani witch doctors have turned many victims into frogs. Some never recover.

Pet.Name: Pint-Sized Pink Pachyderm
Pet.Description: A shy creature, the pink elekk will only make its presence known to those that have befriended it, or to anyone too intoxicated to harm it.

Pet.Name: Tiny Sporebat
Pet.Description: Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions.

Pet.Name: Rocket Chicken
Pet.Description: When the Burning Legion invaded Outland, Landro Longshot contributed this design to the war effort. Both the Alliance and Horde passed on production.

Pet.Name: Dragon Kite
Pet.Description: Much quieter than a real dragon.

Pet.Name: Searing Scorchling
Pet.Description: Elder shaman have warned that wisps of Ragnaros, loyal servants of the Firelord, have taken to the Molten Front. Vigilance is advised.

Pet.Name: Snarly
Pet.Description: Crocolisks are six-legged amphibian predators found in coastal waters. Archaeologists believe they may be descended from the diemetradons of Un'Goro Crater.

Pet.Name: Chuck
Pet.Description: After studying the crocolisk species for several years, the famed angler Nat Pagle determined that baby crocolisks are mostly harmless.

Pet.Name: Phoenix Hatchling
Pet.Description: A child of phoenix god Al'ar, the hatchling takes flight immediately after birth.

Pet.Name: Ethereal Soul-Trader
Pet.Description: Ethereal soul-traders will travel with those who can free the essences they need from unruly hosts.

Pet.Name: Nether Ray Fry
Pet.Description: Native to the Terokkar Forest, nether rays spawn during the rainy season. Out of the hundreds of offspring resulting from one hatching, very few survive to adulthood.

Pet.Name: Ghostly Skull
Pet.Description: When it senses the impending death of a nearby creature, the skull will emit an ear-piercing cackle.

Pet.Name: Clockwork Rocket Bot
Pet.Description: This mechanical warrior is a favorite gift during Winter Veil. Batteries not included, but rockets definitely are!

Pet.Name: Giant Sewer Rat
Pet.Description: You wouldn't want to meet this rat in a dark alley. Or anywhere else, for that matter.

Pet.Name: Tickbird Hatchling
Pet.Description: Unlike most of Geen the gorloc's 'mysterious eggs,' this one actually contained a living thing.

Pet.Name: White Tickbird Hatchling
Pet.Description: The rare albino tickbird is revered amongst the Oracles. It is seen as a sign of heavy rainstorms, good grub harvests, and hibernating wolvar.

Pet.Name: Proto-Drake Whelp
Pet.Description: These voracious whelps grow at an incredible rate and can devour nearly twice their weight in raw meat per day.

Pet.Name: Cobra Hatchling
Pet.Description: The cobras of Azeroth are renowned for their fast-acting venom and swift strikes.

Pet.Name: Pengu
Pet.Description: Notable for its wide eyes and sassy slide.

Pet.Name: Spring Rabbit
Pet.Description: Spring rabbits symbolize fertility, and they love to demonstrate why.

Pet.Name: Teldrassil Sproutling
Pet.Description: It always wakes up dancing. What a happy little tree!

Pet.Name: Dun Morogh Cub
Pet.Description: The bears of Dun Morogh are prized for their hardiness, loyalty, and combat prowess. Their time among the dwarves does little to curb their ferocity.

Pet.Name: Tirisfal Batling
Pet.Description: Can sense an opponent's heartbeat through echolocation.

Pet.Name: Durotar Scorpion
Pet.Description: The volatile Durotar scorpion is a fierce desert predator. It's known for only occasionally stinging its owner.

Pet.Name: Elwynn Lamb
Pet.Description: Unlike the polymorphed variety, trueborn sheep can be quite scary.

Pet.Name: Mulgore Hatchling
Pet.Description: A tallstrider's speed on open ground is unrivaled, so predators rely on stealth and pack tactics when hunting them.

Pet.Name: Strand Crawler
Pet.Description: The strand crawler has adapted to the northern cold by hibernating under the island beaches.

Pet.Name: Ammen Vale Lashling
Pet.Description: The long-term effects of the contamination caused by the Exodar are still under observation.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Broom
Pet.Description: Created by a blood elf apprentice, this broom would be extremely useful if anyone could figure out how to make it stop.

Pet.Name: Mechanopeep
Pet.Description: Used as a training mount for young gnomes, the Mechanopeep has none of the speed but all of the charm of its bigger brothers.

Pet.Name: Sen'jin Fetish
Pet.Description: This is actually three pets in one. You won't know what you'll get until you summon it!

Pet.Name: Calico Cat
Pet.Description: Many have mocked this cat before battle. Their last words are usually, 'Here, kitty, kitty.'

Pet.Name: Shimmering Wyrmling
Pet.Description: This extremely rare species of mana wyrm is prized for its unique coloration and even temperament.

Pet.Name: Darting Hatchling
Pet.Description: Rarely leaves nest until maturity. Enjoys conducting pranks on the nearby Razormaw nest.

Pet.Name: Deviate Hatchling
Pet.Description: The demand for this purple-skinned breed has drastically reduced the raptor population near the Wailing Caverns.

Pet.Name: Gundrak Hatchling
Pet.Description: This crafty raptor was born in the icy wastes of Northrend. Its harsh upbringing gives it strength when many others would perish.

Pet.Name: Leaping Hatchling
Pet.Description: This offspring of Takk the Leaper is incredibly agile and can maneuver through difficult environments with ease.

Pet.Name: Obsidian Hatchling
Pet.Description: This hatchling is coveted for its unique coloration. Despite Breanni's loving care, the raptor's feral nature cannot be restrained.

Pet.Name: Ravasaur Hatchling
Pet.Description: Larger than other raptor infants, these hatchlings grow into towering reptilian beasts capable of massive devastation.

Pet.Name: Razormaw Hatchling
Pet.Description: Razormaw eggs are protected fiercely by their mothers. Their cuteness belies their inherited ferocity.

Pet.Name: Razzashi Hatchling
Pet.Description: Razzashi raptors are among the cleverest predators in the jungle, making them favored by the Gurubashi trolls.

Pet.Name: Tuskarr Kite
Pet.Description: Seeing these kites soaring above Northrend's shores is a clear sign that tuskarr are nearby.

Pet.Name: Spectral Tiger Cub
Pet.Description: Affectionate and curious, these kittens seem to find the most peculiar hiding places.

Pet.Name: Toxic Wasteling
Pet.Description: This, um, 'adorable' little guy likes to play with critters. Just don't let them get too close.

Pet.Name: Frigid Frostling
Pet.Description: While not nearly as destructive as its original master, the Ice Lord Ahune, the frostling has been known to lob chilly snowballs at unsuspecting adventurers.

Pet.Name: Blue Clockwork Rocket Bot
Pet.Description: Jepetto's top-selling toy this season, the bot's new blue chassis has children across Azeroth scrambling for this feisty battle bot.

Pet.Name: Personal World Destroyer
Pet.Description: Goblin engineering at its finest. Blueprints based on the massive fel reaver in Hellfire Peninsula.

Pet.Name: De-Weaponized Mechanical Companion
Pet.Description: The gold standard for sturdy gnomish design, this mechanical critter is the perfect companion for the lonely engineer on the go.

Pet.Name: Crawling Claw
Pet.Description: This appears to be nothing more than the paw of a small primate. A closer inspection shows that the hand has been dried by centuries of exposure to the sands of Uldum.

Pet.Name: Fossilized Hatchling
Pet.Description: You stare at her, and she just stares right back. So clever; sometimes it seems as if she's figuring out how to open doors.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Lantern
Pet.Description: Reduces the likelihood of being eaten by monsters when you enter pitch-black places.

Pet.Name: Rustberg Gull
Pet.Description: This bird is a salty veteran of the endless naval battles surrounding Tol Barad--a veteran whose grown plump from picking through the leftovers, that is.

Pet.Name: Clockwork Gnome
Pet.Description: Thought to be an original construct of the titans, the clockwork gnome has some gears smaller than the eye can see.

Pet.Name: Fox Kit
Pet.Description: The fighting in Tol Barad has made it difficult to find these kits, and numerous would-be owners have decimated the fox population there as a result.

Pet.Name: Tiny Shale Spider
Pet.Description: The elemental shale spider is no true arachnid, but it has durability and ferocity that make it feared even in Deepholm.

Pet.Name: Landro's Lil' XT
Pet.Description: Always 'ready to play,' Landro's Lil' XT is almost indistinguishable from the original. Prone to tantrums and narcolepsy.

Pet.Name: Mr. Grubbs
Pet.Description: The grubs of the Plaguelands are a side effect of necromantic corruption and the massive number of corpses there. Mr. Grubbs is from a particularly acrobatic breed.

Pet.Name: Scooter the Snail
Pet.Description: You'll find him in his shell, exactly where a snail has to be!

Pet.Name: Magic Lamp
Pet.Description: Higitus figi- hockity pocki- abracadab- prestidig--oh, pinfeathers!

Pet.Name: Elementium Geode
Pet.Description: Often confused by miners as a rare gem, the geode initially makes its presence known by emitting melodic reverberations.

Pet.Name: Landro's Lichling
Pet.Description: How the goblin Landro Longshot initially came into possession of the lichling remains a mystery, but he was all too eager to wager it in a game of cards.

Pet.Name: Nightsaber Cub
Pet.Description: Elune made nightsabers silver and black so they could meld into the shadows on a moonlit night.

Pet.Name: Winterspring Cub
Pet.Description: Winterspring cubs are happiest when frolicking in freshly fallen snow.

Pet.Name: Legs
Pet.Description: Wild marsh walkers are dangerously aggressive, but they're loyal and affectionate if you manage to tame them.

Pet.Name: Pterrordax Hatchling
Pet.Description: Pterrordax eggs are incubated underneath the fossils of their forebears, allowing the hatchlings to absorb their ancestors' ferocity and intelligence.

Pet.Name: Voodoo Figurine
Pet.Description: Voodoo figurines were often empowered by flasks of mojo, troll sweat, and the flesh of tribal enemies.

Pet.Name: Guardian Cub
Pet.Description: Still a little clumsy, this tiny winged lion is learning how to be the best mount it can be!

Pet.Name: Hyjal Bear Cub
Pet.Description: The cubs of Hyjal suffered much during the Cataclysm. On the bright side, the devastation also led to their newfound love of heights and daredevil stunts.

Pet.Name: Crimson Lasher
Pet.Description: Native to the ashen soils of the Firelands, the lasher was transplanted to Azeroth with the help of the Guardians of Hyjal.

Pet.Name: Feline Familiar
Pet.Description: Ride with the moon (and this furry, whiskered witch) in the dead of night!

Pet.Name: Purple Puffer
Pet.Description: You might think this fish out of water would be a weak opponent... until you see the intensity that lies within its protective bubble.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Monkey
Pet.Description: The monkeys of Azeroth are infamous tricksters, and these beloved companions of the Darkmoon Faire have taken that innate cunning to a whole new level.

Pet.Name: Gregarious Grell
Pet.Description: The grell are embodiments of the wild side of nature. Tame ones are very rare.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Turtle
Pet.Description: This shelled reptile bravely protects the home on its back with an unwaveringly happy disposition.

Pet.Name: Lumpy
Pet.Description: A stowaway from Greatfather Winter's workshop, this tiny elemental found himself trapped in a present that was stolen by the Abominable Greench.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Tonk
Pet.Description: A favorite of children across Azeroth, this tough little toy can withstand even the most aggressive imagination.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Zeppelin
Pet.Description: Lacking the mines and rockets of its predecessor, this kid-friendly faire prize is a new favorite among Azeroth's children.

Pet.Name: Sea Pony
Pet.Description: Despite its diminutive size, it is impossible to miss a sea pony cutting through the water.

Pet.Name: Lunar Lantern
Pet.Description: These magical lanterns are acquired at the Lunar Festival, which celebrates the defeat of the Burning Legion by the free races of Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Festival Lantern
Pet.Description: The light from each lantern honors the soul of an ancestor spirit. During the Lunar Festival, these ghostly elders pass along their wisdom to the current generation.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Cub
Pet.Description: This snuggly kitten loves to frolic, but sometimes it seems to be chasing things that aren't really there.

Pet.Name: Eye of the Legion
Pet.Description: Always watching. Always judging.

Pet.Name: Porcupette
Pet.Description: Despite the name you should absolutely never, ever pet it.

Pet.Name: Sun Darter Hatchling
Pet.Description: This unique species of faerie dragon is not usually found on Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Shore Crawler
Pet.Description: Only found on the shores of Kezan, this lovely sea creature can be a bit snarky.

Pet.Name: Gilnean Raven
Pet.Description: Quoth the raven: the last word you said. It gets old.

Pet.Name: Terrible Turnip
Pet.Description: And you thought turnips at the dinner table were bad.

Pet.Name: Tiny Goldfish
Pet.Description: This bubble is way worse than a tank.

Pet.Name: Sand Scarab
Pet.Description: Easily mistaken for a common beetle, the sting of a sand scarab will quickly clear up the misconception should you be unlucky enough to be stung by one.

Pet.Name: Jade Crane Chick
Pet.Description: A graceful creature from the isle of Pandaria.

Pet.Name: Grinder
Pet.Description: Mogu sorcerers, keepers of the secret to bringing stone to life, prefer these stolid companions over more beastly familiars.

Pet.Name: Aqua Strider
Pet.Description: Water striders serve an important role in Jinyu culture, acting as a mount, means of sending communications, and even a family pet.

Pet.Name: Mechanical Pandaren Dragonling
Pet.Description: Constructed from a seemingly impossible mass of gears, springs, wires, and a little something special, this dragonling embodies the spirit of Pandaria as seen through an engineer's goggles.

Pet.Name: Jade Owl
Pet.Description: Jade is naturally rich with life and color, making it the perfect raw material for this gentle companion. It is said the wind created by their wings can soothe the troubled mind.

Pet.Name: Sapphire Cub
Pet.Description: While each cub is crafted in the same fashion, tiny imperfections in the gemstones create a unique personality when imbued with life. They are, however, always playful and friendly.

Pet.Name: Fishy
Pet.Description: Many believe (incorrectly) that goldfish have no memories. Trainers who have worked with them know this is clearly not the case and have the bruises to prove it.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Rabbit
Pet.Description: This rabbit is much stronger than it looks.

Pet.Name: Pandaren Water Spirit
Pet.Description: Water spirits are especially mischievous, and are known to frequent the canals of the Stormstout Brewery.

Pet.Name: Imperial Moth
Pet.Description: The larval form of this moth is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Imperial Silkworm
Pet.Description: This plump red caterpillar is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Hatchling
Pet.Description: Most of Violet's numerous forest strider hatchlings are turned into Faire fare by Stamp Thunderhorn, though a few are raised as mounts or purchased by adventurers looking for a petite purple pet.

Pet.Name: Darkmoon Eye
Pet.Description: Don't even think about cheating now.

Pet.Name: Pandaren Fire Spirit
Pet.Description: Though it appears to be a vaguely-related cousin to the Cinder Kitten, the two creatures actually share no ancestry.

Pet.Name: Pandaren Air Spirit
Pet.Description: These spirits represent the heart of Pandaria's elemental powers.

Pet.Name: Pandaren Earth Spirit
Pet.Description: The elements of Pandaria can be cute and playful, until their homeland is threatened.

Pet.Name: Giant Bone Spider
Pet.Description: Found in a dusty egg clutch at the back of Maexxna's lair, these creatures are already undead when they hatch.

Pet.Name: Fungal Abomination
Pet.Description: Loatheb's body is covered in small pods capable of spreading blighted fungal spores up to 1000 yards given proper wind conditions.

Pet.Name: Stitched Pup
Pet.Description: When Gluth died to a band of brave adventurers, these lil' guys were found in the corpse, gnawing on giant, undead bones.

Pet.Name: Harbinger of Flame
Pet.Description: Few of these fiery harbingers remain following Ragnaros' defeat in the Firelands.

Pet.Name: Corefire Imp
Pet.Description: These tiny flame imps roam the Molten Core in large swarms and can replenish their numbers rapidly.

Pet.Name: Ashstone Core
Pet.Description: The cooled core of Golemagg, it appears to retain some semi-sentient properties.

Pet.Name: Untamed Hatchling
Pet.Description: One of Razorgore's eggs that miraculously survived in Blackwing Lair.

Pet.Name: Chrominius
Pet.Description: Opponents that face this fierce chromatic monstrosity just hope it doesn't have Time Stop!

Pet.Name: Death Talon Whelpguard
Pet.Description: A runt of the Black Talon, left to guard the whelps.

Pet.Name: Viscidus Globule
Pet.Description: This small globule didn't make it back to Viscidus in time to re-form.

Pet.Name: Anubisath Idol
Pet.Description: An anubisath idol from the Temple of Ahn'qiraj, infused with ancient qiraji magic.

Pet.Name: Mini Mindslayer
Pet.Description: The bane of many an adventurer, to look into its eyes is to truly know madness.

Pet.Name: Gusting Grimoire
Pet.Description: A fel-tainted tome whose secrets are so terrible and bizarre that its pages have taken on an eerie semblance of life. Found on many a warlock's nightstand.

Pet.Name: Living Sandling
Pet.Description: Born of sand, these dangerous creatures can form and disperse in the blink of an eye.

Pet.Name: Sunreaver Micro-Sentry
Pet.Description: Loyal to the Sunreavers from creation, these pint-sized constructs can still pack a punch.

Pet.Name: Zandalari Kneebiter
Pet.Description: This unique raptor was born on the island of Zandalar and transported here along with the rest of the Zandalari army.

Pet.Name: Son of Animus
Pet.Description: Forged in the Throne of Thunder, these tiny creations are servants of the great Dark Animus.

Pet.Name: Spectral Porcupette
Pet.Description: Something about this creature looks familiar...

Pet.Name: Sunfur Panda
Pet.Description: These cuddly rascals enjoy basking in the sun, sleeping in the sun, and napping in the sun.

Pet.Name: Snowy Panda
Pet.Description: The white fur of the Snowy Panda allows it to hide in the snowbanks of Kun-Lai Summit.

Pet.Name: Mountain Panda
Pet.Description: Cousin to the Snowy Panda, Mountain Pandas reside in the lower regions of Kun-Lai Summit.

Pet.Name: Pygmy Direhorn
Pet.Description: Don't pet the pointy end. Note: all of the ends are pointy.

Pet.Name: Spawn of G'nathus
Pet.Description: Some Pandaren believe G'nathus to be an ancient Zandalari Loa left behind to guard the waters south of Lei Shen's island citadel.

Pet.Name: Ji-Kun Hatchling
Pet.Description: Deadly offspring of the Ancient Mother, Ji-Kun Hatchlings are considered sacred treasures in many cultures.

Pet.Name: Pierre
Pet.Description: Every cook's dream wrapped up in a perfect bundle of metal and bolts. Too bad what he cooks up isn't suitable for humanoid consumption. According to Jard's notes, he intends to make this little guy for his friend, Emily Cole.

Pet.Name: Direhorn Runt
Pet.Description: The Zandalari breed specific Direhorn species for their small size for use as mounts.

Pet.Name: Tiny Red Carp
Pet.Description: The red scales on these fish are believed to be a warning to predators of the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes that their flesh is toxic. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

Pet.Name: Tiny Blue Carp
Pet.Description: These little guys can be found in the waters of the Timeless Isle, or swimming alongside Jewel Danio or Redbelly Mandarin. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

Pet.Name: Tiny Green Carp
Pet.Description: It is believed that the green coloration and stripes on the tiny green carp serve as camouflage in the waters of the Jade Forest, Valley of the Four Winds and the Krasarang Wilds. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

Pet.Name: Tiny White Carp
Pet.Description: These hardy fish can survive in a wide range of climates, from the snow capped mountains of Kun-Lai Summit to the temperate, salty waters of the oceans around Pandaria. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

Pet.Name: Zandalari Anklerender
Pet.Description: These tiny minions of Zandalar are adept at stowing away within the cargo holds of the enormous Zandalari warships.

Pet.Name: Zandalari Footslasher
Pet.Description: Even at this size, these raptors can eviscerate an entire cow in less than 10 seconds.

Pet.Name: Zandalari Toenibbler
Pet.Description: These adorable beasts are both cuddly and huggable, provided you do not enjoy having a face.

Pet.Name: Lil' Bad Wolf
Pet.Description: The oft-forgotten offspring of the Big Bad Wolf, found gorged and asleep in a basket of sweets.

Pet.Name: Menagerie Custodian
Pet.Description: Primary responsibilities include dusting Medivh's many magical artifacts, an activity which has claimed the life, sanity, or physical composition of the many caretakers preceding Moroes.

Pet.Name: Netherspace Abyssal
Pet.Description: Upon leaving Netherspace, Malchezaar's Abyssals become strangely distorted by Karazhan's magical protections, rendering them tiny, and much less likely to spontaneously erupt in flames.

Pet.Name: Fiendish Imp
Pet.Description: A minion of Terestian Illhoof, this tricky imp was left in Karazhan when the portal to the Twisting Nether closed behind it.

Pet.Name: Tideskipper
Pet.Description: An astounding find for the scientific community of Azeroth, who have long pondered, often in taverns, what a baby Sea Giant might look like.

Pet.Name: Tainted Waveling
Pet.Description: The spawn of Hydross, considered by the elemental community to be the "Earl of Puddles."

Pet.Name: Coilfang Stalker
Pet.Description: It is unknown how Lady Vashj empowers these Fen Striders with their mind-bending powers; even at an early age this creature shows significant psychic ability.

Pet.Name: Pocket Reaver
Pet.Description: Sent through the Twisting Nether by the great Archimonde the Defiler to terrorize tiny civilizations with their medium-sized stomping noises.

Pet.Name: Lesser Voidcaller
Pet.Description: The lanterns carried by Voidcallers bridge the realms of the living and the dead, and often attract wayward ghosts and spirits.

Pet.Name: Phoenix Hawk Hatchling
Pet.Description: These brightly-colored dragonhawks carry Kael'thas' forces swiftly and unerringly through the nether storm surrounding the Eye.

Pet.Name: Gahz'rooki
Pet.Description: The trolls have a long and storied history of summoning hydras. While he might not be the biggest or strongest hydra, Gahz'rooki will bite your fingers quite hard if you get too close.

Pet.Name: Living Fluid
Pet.Description: The dark pools in Primordius' chamber laid stagnant after the fall of the mogu, and murky thoughts began to coalesce.

Pet.Name: Viscous Horror
Pet.Description: These malicious oozes are highly sensitive to Primordius' pheromone signature.

Pet.Name: Filthling
Pet.Description: Battle pet trainers are strongly encouraged to wash their hands for at least 30 minutes after playing with the filthling.

Pet.Name: Rascal-Bot
Pet.Description: This little guy seems to like to hang out at the fringes of cataclysmic events. There is no evidence to suggest he has anything to do with the cause of these events, though - he's probably just an observer. Or maybe he just gets lost on his trek to other places.

Pet.Name: Moon Moon
Pet.Description: Moonfang's cubs grow into massive, slavering, black-furred killing machines...except for Moon Moon.

Pet.Name: Lil' Bling
Pet.Description: This handsome little robot is the spitting image of his "Dad", Blingtron 4000. As a Blingtron's generosity circuits don't mature until they have been built to maximum specification, you shouldn't expect any free handouts from him.

Pet.Name: Azure Crane Chick
Pet.Description: Crane chicks of the Timeless Isle sometimes sing a curious song that calms the nerves and soothes the soul.

Pet.Name: Blackfuse Bombling
Pet.Description: The first bombling created in the Underhold, Siegecrafter Blackfuse couldn't bear to see it destroyed, and kept it as a friendly, if explosive, pet.

Pet.Name: Ashleaf Spriteling
Pet.Description: The Ashleaf Sprites of the Timeless Isle tirelessly protect the vegetation of the island from the burning fury of Ordos and his minions.

Pet.Name: Ruby Droplet
Pet.Description: The waters of Ruby Lake are colored a strange reddish hue, possibly due to the ruby crystals found deep within the mountains of the Timeless Isle.

Pet.Name: Dandelion Frolicker
Pet.Description: While fascinated by flowers, the frolicker has also been known to dance with blades of grass and the occasional weed.

Pet.Name: Death Adder Hatchling
Pet.Description: Late in life, if the environmental conditions are correct, a Death Adder may shed its skin and undergo a transformation into an Imperial Python.

Pet.Name: Droplet of Y'Shaarj
Pet.Description: A small remnant of the power of Y'shaarj that spawned the Sha, a single Drop of Y'shaarj can magnify emotional states for thousands of yards, causing entire towns to shut down in fear or doubt.

Pet.Name: Gooey Sha-ling
Pet.Description: Sha-lings reflect the emotional state of their handler, becoming agitated, depressed, fearful, or doubtful depending on the magnitude of negative thoughts around them.

Pet.Name: Jademist Dancer
Pet.Description: The Jademist Dancers of the Timeless Isle have a curious attraction to the steam vents of the northwestern shore.

Pet.Name: Kovok
Pet.Description: The tiny terror of the Dread Wastes, Kovok prefers a steady diet of "brain food:" mushan brains, human brains, any brains really. This strange nutritional requirement may be tangentally related to his enormous head.

Pet.Name: Ominous Flame
Pet.Description: The odd blue flames found within the Cavern of Lost Spirits have led many unwary adventurers to their doom.

Pet.Name: Skunky Alemental
Pet.Description: When the village of Pi'jiu was attacked by the Ordon Yaungol generations ago, the villagers bravely erected a keg in the center of the village. The following morning, after the celebration had died down, the still-drunken Yaungol blearily agreed to a peace treaty.

Pet.Name: Spineclaw Crab
Pet.Description: Spineclaw crabs of Pandaria have existed for thousands of years and remain one of the continent's oldest creatures.

Pet.Name: Gulp Froglet
Pet.Description: Gulp frogs of the Timeless Isle can feast upon prey several times larger than themselves by slowly digesting the victim externally with a toxic slime.

Pet.Name: Bonkers
Pet.Description: Some young and rambunctious hozen are trained from an early age to use boxing gloves so they don't accidentally kill their tribe members, and more importantly, to keep them from picking their noses.

Pet.Name: Vengeful Porcupette
Pet.Description: One of the beasts left on the Timeless Isle when it shifted through time, most likely sacrificed by the Ordon to their demigod, Ordos.

Pet.Name: Gu'chi Swarmling
Pet.Description: Swarmlings of Gu'chi spin an ancient, and very powerful, form of silk that has not been seen in Pandaria in ages.

Pet.Name: Harmonious Porcupette
Pet.Description: Prolonged exposure to Shaohao's tranquil mists has calmed these spirits, which act as peaceful companions to the Mistweavers.

Pet.Name: Jadefire Spirit
Pet.Description: The Jadefire Spirit is thought to be a living embodiment of Yu'lon's own jade breath.

Pet.Name: Rotten Little Helper
Pet.Description: Fed up with long hours, low pay, and entitled adventurers whining about sub-standard Winter Veil gifts, these nasty little creatures fled their magical workshops to join up with the Abominable Greench.

Pet.Name: Macabre Marionette
Pet.Description: These possessed puppets are given a semblance of life by whimsical spirits of the departed.

Pet.Name: Albino Chimaeraling
Pet.Description: Both heads are equally fearsome on the terrifying chimaera, each capable of its own unique breath attack.

Pet.Name: Iron Starlette
Pet.Description: This massive weapon of destruction has been miniaturized for use in the garden. Moles beware!

Pet.Name: Weebomination
Pet.Description: Made from bits and pieces of vanquished battle pets, dark magic, and just a pinch of love.

Pet.Name: Lil' Leftovers
Pet.Description: Cute enough to eat, but not recommended.

Pet.Name: Crazy Carrot
Pet.Description: Left to their own devices, carrots will simply lose their minds.

Pet.Name: Lifelike Mechanical Frostboar
Pet.Description: After many complaints that taming young boars was a painful experience, engineers came to the rescue with this creepily lifelike model.

Pet.Name: Teroclaw Hatchling
Pet.Description: The teroclaw is a potent hunter of the small and furry.

Pet.Name: Elekk Plushie
Pet.Description: This adorable little elephant is always there for you.

Pet.Name: Zomstrok
Pet.Description: Zomstrok is evil incarnate, the unholy mistake of someone maddened by isolation, a creation that could not be undone.

Pet.Name: Autumnal Sproutling
Pet.Description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

Pet.Name: Forest Sproutling
Pet.Description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

Pet.Name: Nightshade Sproutling
Pet.Description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

Pet.Name: Sun Sproutling
Pet.Description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

Pet.Name: Ghastly Kid
Pet.Description: In the ultimate demonstration of stubborness, this once-living nannie simply refused to die.

Pet.Name: Meadowstomper Calf
Pet.Description: The intelligence and caring nature of elekk calves make them a stalwart lifelong companion.

Pet.Name: Sea Calf
Pet.Description: The sea calf has a natural affinity for balancing things.

Pet.Name: Draenei Micro Defender
Pet.Description: While these tiny mechanical guardians were created to protect domesticated elekks from pests, they also turned out to be really good at giving back massages.

Pet.Name: River Calf
Pet.Description: Surprisingly quick when provoked, but easily calmed with a meal of Nagrand arrowbloom.

Pet.Name: Bone Wasp
Pet.Description: One ogre ritual involves cupping a bone wasp in their hands and shaking vigorously. The venom increases strength and invokes vivid imagery.

Pet.Name: Sky-Bo
Pet.Description: The Sky-Bo was originally designed by the infamous Millie Watt as a toy for her cat. The cat just slept in the box next to it.

Pet.Name: Fruit Hunter
Pet.Description: This anxious avian has a voracious appetite for fruit.

Pet.Name: Syd the Squid
Pet.Description: This tiny squid seems to enjoy wearing pants, but where in the world would you find some that fit?

Pet.Name: Ore Eater
Pet.Description: They eat and eat and eat, until they grow large. Then they eat some more.

Pet.Name: Lovebird Hatchling
Pet.Description: Of course there are hatchlings, they're called Lovebirds aren't they?

Pet.Name: Stonegrinder
Pet.Description: The master-crafted gear assembly and precision joints in this robot are clearly made with love.

Pet.Name: Bush Chicken
Pet.Description: Following their introduction to the mainland by the goblins, Bush Chickens have become the entre du jour for Pilgrim's Bounty due to their high deliciousness and low intelligence.

Pet.Name: Blazing Cindercrawler
Pet.Description: Tiny, incinerated corpses of various insects line its cage.

Pet.Name: Stout Alemental
Pet.Description: The Pandaren Brewmasters accidentally brought a barrel of Uncle Gao's last sentient batch of brew with them to Brewfest.

Pet.Name: Cursed Birman
Pet.Description: One of this cat's nine lives has returned to haunt the living by yowling loudly when you're trying to sleep.

Pet.Name: Widget the Departed
Pet.Description: Not even death would stop this kitten's insatiable curiosity.

Pet.Name: Netherspawn, Spawn of Netherspawn
Pet.Description: This slime has a long and confusing lineage.

Pet.Name: Frostwolf Ghostpup
Pet.Description: The little wolf told to stay. Watching, waiting, for vacant prey. Too proud to leave, she slipped away. Unburdened now, forever free to play.

Pet.Name: Ancient Nest Guardian
Pet.Description: The ancient nest guardian was designed with the unthinkable in mind: to hate cats.

Pet.Name: Ikky
Pet.Description: Kaliri hatchlings feast on grubs when they're young, and eventually graduate to anything smaller than themselves.

Pet.Name: Lanticore Spawnling
Pet.Description: No one knows what deep part of Blackwing Descent the Lanticore was kept in, but it probably smelled pretty awful.

Pet.Name: Zangar Spore
Pet.Description: In Draenor, the Zangar Sea seeks to overtake the land by releasing thousands of these spores and slowly growing inland over time.

Pet.Name: Crimson Spore
Pet.Description: A spore plucked from the Crimson Fen, an area of Gorgrond that was swallowed when Draenor was torn apart by nether magics.

Pet.Name: Umbrafen Spore
Pet.Description: The deep blue Umbrafen would later become home to a tribe of Broken.

Pet.Name: Seaborne Spore
Pet.Description: A spore from Zangarra, a central area of the Zangar encroachment that would later bloom into the Zangarmarsh.

Pet.Name: Brilliant Spore
Pet.Description: Brilliant spores are very rarely seen, found deep under the waves of Draenor within the darkest corners of the Zangar fungal encroachment.

Pet.Name: Hydraling
Pet.Description: The hydraling can be an expensive pet, as it is capable of eating from three food bowls at the same time.

Pet.Name: Frostwolf Pup
Pet.Description: These pups are bundles of fur and teeth until they grow up, at which point they are really just teeth.

Pet.Name: Hatespark the Tiny
Pet.Description: His hate is not diminished by size.

Pet.Name: Firewing
Pet.Description: Don't line her cage with paper unless you want a fire.

Pet.Name: Bronze Whelpling
Pet.Description: The Bronze Whelpling was lost in time until an unusual event allowed her to escape.

Pet.Name: Doom Bloom
Pet.Description: A clear indication why goblin fertilizers should be used sparingly.

Pet.Name: Mechanical Scorpid
Pet.Description: Iron, iron, steel and fire. Bellows, gears, plates, and wire.

Pet.Name: Everbloom Peachick
Pet.Description: These tiny creatures seem to favor big, fluffy nests, preferably atop an animal-loving dryad.

Pet.Name: Sentinel's Companion
Pet.Description: The companion of a night elf sentinel, rarely given out as a gift.

Pet.Name: Puddle Terror
Pet.Description: Living so closely to the water's surface, the puddle terror is not only friend to all aquatic creatures, it is one.

Pet.Name: Soul of the Forge
Pet.Description: When forging enchanted steel, bits of magic seep into the coals. Over a period of years, decades even, the unbound energy slowly takes form, creating a tiny elemental being of immense fortitude.

Pet.Name: Sunfire Kaliri
Pet.Description: Legend says the Sunfire Kaliri flies into the sun itself when it is ready to die.

Pet.Name: Albino River Calf
Pet.Description: Their white hide would make them vulnerable to sunburn, if it wasn't as thick as plate armor.

Pet.Name: Son of Sethe
Pet.Description: Godlike being now in travel size.

Pet.Name: Sky Fry
Pet.Description: Playing fetch with a ray is always fun. You don't even have to aim.

Pet.Name: Eye of Observation
Pet.Description: You'll always feel like... something is watching you.

Pet.Name: Bloodthorn Hatchling
Pet.Description: Ravagers are favored ogre snacks when they are small and less deadly.

Pet.Name: Dusty Sporewing
Pet.Description: Their wings emit a fine powder as a defensive mechanism when it is in danger.

Pet.Name: Veilwatcher Hatchling
Pet.Description: Hunted to near extinction for its feathers, thie kaliri has developed keen senses.

Pet.Name: Kaliri Hatchling
Pet.Description: Hunted to near extinction for its feathers, the kaliri has developed keen senses.

Pet.Name: Glowing Sporebat
Pet.Description: Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions.

Pet.Name: Bone Serpent
Pet.Description: Young bone serpents will try to burrow into a living creature's skull and devour their brain. So you may want to wear a night cap.

Pet.Name: Servant of Demidos
Pet.Description: Demidos created a great many servants when he was hosting parties for other void lords.

Pet.Name: Grotesque
Pet.Description: A smaller gargoyle that is used to divert the flow of rainwater on scourge buildings to prevent mausoleum flooding.

Pet.Name: Leviathan Hatchling
Pet.Description: The dark green water in the Black Temple's sewer system gives these hydras their distinctive color.

Pet.Name: Abyssius
Pet.Description: A fragment of the great abyssal Supremus, Abyssius contains enough fiery essence to burn a hole right through your pocket.

Pet.Name: Fragment of Anger
Pet.Description: It's just a little mad.

Pet.Name: Fragment of Suffering
Pet.Description: It's only mildly irritated.

Pet.Name: Fragment of Desire
Pet.Description: It's only somewhat interested.

Pet.Name: Sister of Temptation
Pet.Description: She's the devil on your shoulder, whispering in your ear.

Pet.Name: Stinkrot
Pet.Description: What's that smell?

Pet.Name: Hyjal Wisp
Pet.Description: Hundreds of these wisps came together to defend Hyjal from Archimonde and save the world.

Pet.Name: Sunblade Micro-Defender
Pet.Description: Because you don't want to know what happens when a rat wanders into the Sunwell.

Pet.Name: Chaos Pup
Pet.Description: The Twisting Nether is an infinite abyss of terrors and one small corner of extreme cuteness.

Pet.Name: Wretched Servant
Pet.Description: Magic-addicted elves too small and frail to serve in Kil'Jaeden's army were relegated to servant roles for the higher-class demons.

Pet.Name: Slithershock Elver
Pet.Description: The rivers of Draenor are filled with moray. They are vicious predators, attacking anything that enters the water.

Pet.Name: Young Talbuk
Pet.Description: Talbuk grow their horns to full size at an early age.

Pet.Name: Lost Netherpup
Pet.Description: Rumor has it that some beasts that were touched by the void exist in a space between this world and the next.

Pet.Name: Cinder Pup
Pet.Description: Found munching on a blackened bone in the Black Forge of Blackrock Foundry, this pup really seems to warm up to you quickly.

Pet.Name: Periwinkle Calf
Pet.Description: These playful little riverbeasts enjoy scooping up a large mouthful of water and then spitting it at one another.

Pet.Name: Nightmare Bell
Pet.Description: Once a holy artifact used by draenei priests to calm spirits, it has become animated by anguished souls and drawn to locations of death and corruption.

Pet.Name: Ghostshell Crab
Pet.Description: These crabs have developed an advanced form of camouflage that causes their skin to appear translucent.

Pet.Name: Corrupted Nest Guardian
Pet.Description: There is very little difference between a corrupted nest guardian and an omelette chef.

Pet.Name: Left Shark
Pet.Description: Who would leave such a cute shark behind? The Iron Horde truly has no soul.

Pet.Name: Crusher
Pet.Description: Found wandering in a small blizzard, this lost goren carries a mining pick to show that he is a jack of all trades.

Pet.Name: Shard of Cyrukh
Pet.Description: A small amount of Cyrukh burns everlasting within this portion of the Cipher. Best keep it close to you.

Pet.Name: Savage Cub
Pet.Description: Pets often look a lot like their owners, which is especially true if the owner was a saberon.

Pet.Name: Blazing Firehawk
Pet.Description: Arakkoa sun worship has resulted in the creation of some strange and monstrous minions.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Cauldron
Pet.Description: Strega the Hag enchanted her cauldron to prevent it from tipping over and spilling hot soup. She never expected it to achieve sentience and attempt to murder her.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Torch
Pet.Description: Strega the Hag didn't like carrying her own torches. One quick enchantment, and the thing would dutifully follow her into the night.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Pen
Pet.Description: Strega the Hag, tired of writing thank you notes, used her magic to automate the task. Unfortunately, the pen had a dark side and all the recipients received strongly worded letters...

Pet.Name: Grumpy
Pet.Description: You saved him, but maybe he saved you.

Pet.Name: Ashmaw Cub
Pet.Description: This little guy has had a rough start at life, be sure to take good care of him.

Pet.Name: Skyhorn Nestling
Pet.Description: A very rare bird, but this one was intrusted to you.

Pet.Name: Fledgling Warden Owl
Pet.Description: A young companion in need of training.

Pet.Name: Extinguished Eye
Pet.Description: What was once a great enemy is now an adorable friend!

Pet.Name: Eye of Inquisition
Pet.Description: Hello. Is it me you're looking for?

Pet.Name: Emmigosa
Pet.Description: The great-great-great-great-great granddaughter of Senegos.

Pet.Name: Stormborne Whelpling
Pet.Description: Its scales are electrified, making it exceedingly tricky to cuddle.

Pet.Name: Nightmare Whelpling
Pet.Description: What's a little corruption between friends?

Pet.Name: Grumpling
Pet.Description: Grumplings are created when the tears of a kidnapped child fall upon a mound of new snow.

Pet.Name: Nursery Spider
Pet.Description: Why is it called a nursery spider? Does it prefer to lurk in nurseries? Why would it do that? What does it do there? Oh, dear! Someone check on the kids!

Pet.Name: Crispin
Pet.Description: Oddly, he was named Crispin even before the incident.

Pet.Name: Bleakwater Jelly
Pet.Description: When a helsquid has devoured most of the food in any area, it can return to its polyp form and begin life anew.

Pet.Name: Sewer-Pipe Jelly
Pet.Description: Dalaran's drainage is not as good as you think.

Pet.Name: Plump Jelly
Pet.Description: Once its tentacles take hold there is no escape, much like its love for you.

Pet.Name: Ridgeback Piglet
Pet.Description: He loves to play in the mud! Then he likes to give you a hug!

Pet.Name: Thaumaturgical Piglet
Pet.Description: The formula had a bit too much... purple.

Pet.Name: Fel Piglet
Pet.Description: Even piglets are not safe from the Legion's corruption. Although, this one seems harmless enough.

Pet.Name: Energized Manafiend
Pet.Description: Energized by the ogre-mages of Highmaul, this mana-hungry creature will drain you dry before you know it.

Pet.Name: Empyreal Manafiend
Pet.Description: A shimmering creature made of pure arcane energy, it is hard to focus your eyes directly on it.

Pet.Name: Empowered Manafiend
Pet.Description: First created in the presence of Highmaul runes, this tiny manafiend really packs a punch!

Pet.Name: Fetid Waveling
Pet.Description: After a long night out mages find that their water elementals smell a bit off.

Pet.Name: Thistleleaf Adventurer
Pet.Description: Leaving the forest to see the world, which must look so much bigger to such a little guy.

Pet.Name: Risen Saber Kitten
Pet.Description: Eternally cute.

Pet.Name: Alarm-o-Bot
Pet.Description: For Sale: Slightly used Alarm-o-Bot. Rebuilt and refurbished. Still annoying.

Pet.Name: Knockoff Blingtron
Pet.Description: Don't want to break the bank on that new robot? Have a little helper at half the cost! Come down to Goblin Experimental Engineering Korporation and put in your order! All sales final.

Pet.Name: Leyline Broodling
Pet.Description: When demons, nightmares, and magic collide!

Pet.Name: Baby Elderhorn
Pet.Description: Isn't baby elderhorn an oxymoron?

Pet.Name: Sunborne Val'kyr
Pet.Description: Val'kyr are considered "sunborne" when they are honored in the presence of Odyn.

Pet.Name: Trigger
Pet.Description: Ever wanted to cuddle with a gun? Introducing Trigger, the Cuter Shooter.

Pet.Name: Wyrmy Tunkins
Pet.Description: In his home realm, he commanded an army of ten million demons. Now his power is yours to command. Go make him fight a chicken!

Pet.Name: Felbat Pup
Pet.Description: A felbat's fire never burns its master.

Pet.Name: Pygmy Owl
Pet.Description: No size jokes, please.

Pet.Name: Sting Ray Pup
Pet.Description: These fast and nimble swimmers are highly desired by pet collectors. Though they can appear friendly, their tail stinger can kill on contact.

Pet.Name: Transmutant
Pet.Description: When alchemy goes wrong... So, so, wrong.

Pet.Name: Untethered Wyrmling
Pet.Description: A wyrmlings temperment hinges primarily on how long its been since its fed on mana. Remember to feed your pets.

Pet.Name: Lurking Owl Kitten
Pet.Description: It's a bird! It's a cat! It's... biting me...

Pet.Name: Hungering Claw
Pet.Description: Thousands of years ago, ten magisters were exiled from Highborne society for seeking power in the corrupting darkness. In the wilds, they found hunger, desperation, and Kosumoth.

Pet.Name: Ash'ana
Pet.Description: One of Ash'alah's litter, entrusted to you by the Dreamweavers.

Pet.Name: Firebat Pup
Pet.Description: Fire it up!

Pet.Name: Corgnelius
Pet.Description: True royalty among Corgis.

Pet.Name: Court Scribe
Pet.Description: Ghosts are voracious readers.

Pet.Name: Benax
Pet.Description: Younger brother to Anax. Big brother to Cenax and Denax.

Pet.Name: Noblegarden Bunny
Pet.Description: Why do bunnies lay eggs?

Pet.Name: Igneous Flameling
Pet.Description: Who's ready for a hot stone massage?

Pet.Name: Dreadmaw
Pet.Description: Deep beneath the Argent Tournament grounds a clutch of eggs belonging to mates Acidmaw and Dreadscale was found.

Pet.Name: Snobold Runt
Pet.Description: Really much more tolerable when he's not riding on your head.

Pet.Name: Nerubian Swarmer
Pet.Description: Thousands of these skittering nightmares swarm underneath Northrend to this day.

Pet.Name: Magma Rageling
Pet.Description: In the eternal balance of frost and fire, the raging flames fuel many aggressive fronts.

Pet.Name: Ironbound Proto-Whelp
Pet.Description: The denizens of Ulduar transformed even small whelps into ironclad monstrosities.

Pet.Name: Runeforged Servitor
Pet.Description: The runeforged sentries of Ulduar march endlessly without the need for rest or recharging.

Pet.Name: Sanctum Cub
Pet.Description: Rub its belly more than twice and you're just asking to be pounced on.

Pet.Name: Winter Rageling
Pet.Description: In the eternal balance of frost and fire, the stolid ice forms a defense without measure.

Pet.Name: Snaplasher
Pet.Description: Glowing from within, these sprouts have been blessed with a gift from Eonar.

Pet.Name: G0-R41-0N Ultratonk
Pet.Description: The next level of scrapbot technology: pushes the scrap into a heap, then destroys it with flame vents and rockets.

Pet.Name: Creeping Tentacle
Pet.Description: There is something deeply unsettling about the tentacle, perhaps it is best not to look at it for too long.

Pet.Name: Boneshard
Pet.Description: A small fragment of Lord Marrowgar, it will NOT stop assaulting your shins.

Pet.Name: Blood Boil
Pet.Description: It really seems to want to touch you, but why?

Pet.Name: Blightbreath
Pet.Description: The eternal answer to the question 'what's that smell?'

Pet.Name: Soulbroken Whelpling
Pet.Description: The Lich King tore the spirits of Sindragosa's lost whelps into undeath in front of her skeletal form as a final affront to the great dragon.

Pet.Name: Drudge Ghoul
Pet.Description: One of innumerable ghouls summoned by the Lich King in his final battle, left to roam the world for eternity.

Pet.Name: Wicked Soul
Pet.Description: An unrepentant soul that was once trapped inside Frostmourne, and now flits restlessly between worlds.

Pet.Name: Albino Buzzard
Pet.Description: Crysa has collected many exotic avians in her travels, none more rare than this hatchling.

Pet.Name: Everliving Spore
Pet.Description: In the fertile grounds of the Wailing Caverns, nothing truly dies.

Pet.Name: Cavern Moccasin
Pet.Description: This serpent seems used to being at your side, it may have been the companion of one of the other druids of the fang.

Pet.Name: Young Venomfang
Pet.Description: Untouched by the deviate corruption seeping through the Wailing Caverns.

Pet.Name: Dibbler
Pet.Description: This tiny robot specializes in drilling, clamping, and shooting lightning out of its brain. A typical gnome invention.

Pet.Name: Naxxy
Pet.Description: It's just constantly barfing plague fluid. Where does it come from? Where does it go?

Pet.Name: Scraps
Pet.Description: He's one cowardly companion, because he's got no guts...

Pet.Name: Orphaned Felbat
Pet.Description: Sure are a lot of these around the Broken Shore.

Pet.Name: Sneaky Marmot
Pet.Description: This marmot has been with you this entire time. He's that good.

Pet.Name: Dig Rat
Pet.Description: Rogues often kept a few of these in their pockets in times of emergency. Don't ask me why.

Pet.Name: Bronze Proto-Whelp
Pet.Description: The Bronze Proto-Whelps have been discovered only in the most peculiar of timelines.

Pet.Name: Ageless Bronze Drake
Pet.Description: This particular drake has oddly retained its age throughout its travels, but its size has certainly changed.

Pet.Name: Ghost Shark
Pet.Description: Queen Azshara's curse over the denizens of Azsuna did not only affect the night elves. This shark is doomed to an eternity of bottomless hunger.

Pet.Name: Tinytron
Pet.Description: During their years-long war with the black dragonflight, the dwarves tried crafting smaller golems that were more difficult to hit.

Pet.Name: Discarded Experiment
Pet.Description: Maloriak was nothing if not resourceful, not letting even small scraps of flesh go to waste.

Pet.Name: Rattlejaw
Pet.Description: Nefarian's reanimated bone constructs were an effective way to combat the many adventurers that plagued him, and especially their mages.

Pet.Name: Twilight Clutch-Sister
Pet.Description: Even very small things can be corrupted, the apocalypse is for everyone.

Pet.Name: Bound Stream
Pet.Description: Amongst the rudest of the Twilight's Hammer's corrupting activities was binding the elements of small streams and brooks.

Pet.Name: Faceless Minion
Pet.Description: It has no eyes, but it always seems to be staring at you.

Pet.Name: Zephyrian Prince
Pet.Description: A minor diety of wind, lording over the tiny breezes that make you think the heat of the summer season will be bearable for a brief moment.

Pet.Name: Drafty
Pet.Description: If you feel a slight gust that made you shiver, that was probably Drafty.

Pet.Name: Blazehound
Pet.Description: Some say it's the pup of Riplimb and Rageface, others say 'I don't want to think about that.'

Pet.Name: Cinderweb Recluse
Pet.Description: A rarely-seen cinderweb species known for devouring her mate's legs and laying eggs in his still-twitching body, and a lovely purple color.

Pet.Name: Surger
Pet.Description: Five things he can never do without: surging, surging, surging, surging, surging.

Pet.Name: Infernal Pyreclaw
Pet.Description: During his time in the Firelands, Fandral would often grow bored and work shaping magic on the local flora and fauna.

Pet.Name: Faceless Mindlasher
Pet.Description: Can't quite take over your mind, but capable of giving you a really bad migraine.

Pet.Name: Corrupted Blood
Pet.Description: Some fragments of Deathwing's blood live on to this day, deep within the lost places of the world, forever seeking their lost host.

Pet.Name: Unstable Tendril
Pet.Description: Its friends call it "Slappy."

Pet.Name: Fel Lasher
Pet.Description: Beautiful and deadly.

Pet.Name: Docile Skyfin
Pet.Description: Skyfin can be observed in a wide variety of colors. Biologists believe the vibrancy of those colors both help attract mates and ward predators.

Pet.Name: Fel-Afflicted Skyfin
Pet.Description: Watch out when it spits.

Pet.Name: Grasping Manifestation
Pet.Description: Reaching out from some vast unknown corner of the void... to give you a hug.

Pet.Name: Fossorial Bile Larva
Pet.Description: If a bile larva stays burrowed for an extended period of time they begin to lose their pigment. When they finally do emerge, they can be quite ravenous.

Pet.Name: Rebellious Imp
Pet.Description: What are they rebelling against? The real question is what are they NOT rebelling against.

Pet.Name: Dart
Pet.Description: This young crawgling was rescued from a vicious blood troll war camp. With care, and lots of feeding, you earned his trust and Krag'wa asked you to take care of him always.

Pet.Name: Silithid Mini-Tank
Pet.Description: This silithid battle tank evolved prematurely. It will never reach full size, but it is just as ferocious as its larger cousins.

Pet.Name: Spawn of Merektha
Pet.Description: Not much is known about the great snake Merektha and the many eggs in the Temple of Sethraliss, but the residents of Zandalar all seem to have a distinct amount of both respect and fear for these serpents.

Pet.Name: Filthy Slime
Pet.Description: You're not entirely sure where this came from, nor do you really want to know, but you are sure that it does eat a tremendous amount of garbage.

Pet.Name: Poda
Pet.Description: Poda was just a small part of the larger business, always trying to live up to the standards of his older brother Coda.

Pet.Name: Smoochums
Pet.Description: Smoochums loved life in Glenbrook, it was full of people to play with and places to sleep, and also where unspeakable acts happen at the most innocent of tea parties.

Pet.Name: Guardian Cobra Hatchling
Pet.Description: A newly hatched Cobra can be just as deadly as a fully grown one, if not more.

Pet.Name: Vengeful Chicken
Pet.Description: The wisest engineers of Azeroth all know that the only thing more dangerous than a living evil chicken, is the mind of an evil chicken transplanted into the body of a mechanical chicken.

Pet.Name: Lil' Tika
Pet.Description: Most predators favored the soft parts of their prey to attack first. Lil' Tika prefers to go for the face.

Pet.Name: Direhorn Hatchling
Pet.Description: The Direhorn species is among the toughest and strongest of all things that walk on Azeroth. They can seem like gentle giants, but be cautious that you don't find yourself in front of one when they are on a warpath.

Pet.Name: Taptaf
Pet.Description: Taptaf is loyal beyond a doubt, as long as food is provided.

Pet.Name: Restored Revenant
Pet.Description: The Drustvar people learned over time that when burying someone or some thing that there are sadly a number of shady people looking to exhume and reanimate whatever they can find.

Pet.Name: Enchanted Tiki Mask
Pet.Description: The Zandalari are masters of magic and communications with the spirits, and they often imbued items with powers to strengthen their bonds with the spirit world.

Pet.Name: Abyssal Eel
Pet.Description: When the Naga invaded Stormsong, they brought their favored pets: Abyssal Eels.

Pet.Name: Seabreeze Bumblebee
Pet.Description: These hardy bees form the backbone of a great honey and mead industry. For decades, the Tidesages forbade anyone from taking them outside of Stormsong.

Pet.Name: Corlain Falcon
Pet.Description: Corlain Falcons are trained from birth to be scouts and fighting companions. The few spared from the Heartsbane curse serve the Order of Embers in the same capacity.

Pet.Name: Drustvar Piglet
Pet.Description: This piglet avoided being turned into sausage at the hands of Roland with the help of a cunning spider.

Pet.Name: Frenzied Cottontail
Pet.Description: This red-nosed bunny is incredibly soft to the touch; just watch your fingers.

Pet.Name: Bilefang Skitterer
Pet.Description: Silver dust sparkling on each of this spider's legs attracts prey; unwittingly drawn into an inescapable web.

Pet.Name: Greatwing Macaw
Pet.Description: Best not to park your mount beneath this one.

Pet.Name: Mechanical Prairie Dog
Pet.Description: This adorable mass of whirlers, cogs, and sprockets wasn't assembled in Gnomeregan. Where then?

Pet.Name: Wicker Pup
Pet.Description: She loves tummy rubs. Just watch out for splinters.

Pet.Name: Tiny Direhorn
Pet.Description: A popular pet among children, despite frequent accidental gorings.

Pet.Name: Zandalari Shinchomper
Pet.Description: Known to chomp on the shins of everything from saurids to brutosaurs.

Pet.Name: Bloodfeaster Larva
Pet.Description: Exceptionally squishy, especially after a big meal.

Pet.Name: Tragg the Curious
Pet.Description: Krag'wa reluctantly sent Tragg to the Talanji Expedition with the hope that they could find someone suitable to escort him on a tour of Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Lil' Ben'fon
Pet.Description: White Brutosaurs were on the brink of extinction until some enterprising adventurers took action. Lil' Ben'fon may have inherited her father's size, but definitely has her mother's temper!

Pet.Name: Ranishu Runt
Pet.Description: Always hungry, and has a shockingly good personality.

Pet.Name: Child of Jani
Pet.Description: The scavenger Loa thinks you can teach this saurid a thing or two. Just don't lose sight of your coin purse.

Pet.Name: Swamp Toad
Pet.Description: These toads do not appreciate having their legs pulled off.

Pet.Name: Accursed Hexxer
Pet.Description: No one knows where this haunted tiki mask came from, or why its so angry all the time. It seems to like you though!

Pet.Name: Saurolisk Hatchling
Pet.Description: They are so cute before they develop razor-sharp teeth and venom.

Pet.Name: Blue Flitter
Pet.Description: So pretty you could eat it. But don't. It's poisonous.

Pet.Name: Freshwater Pincher
Pet.Description: Finding freshwater pearls with this crab by your side will be a pinch.

Pet.Name: Crimson Frog
Pet.Description: This frog's peculiar red color appears to have evolved specifically for camouflage in blood. Spooky.

Pet.Name: Barnacled Hermit Crab
Pet.Description: She just wanted to get away. Find a nice shell. Sit on a beach. Now she's your pet.

Pet.Name: Sandstinger Wasp
Pet.Description: It is a well-established fact that wasps produce far higher quality honey than bees. Well-established in very, very small circles of wasp farmers.

Pet.Name: Cou'pa
Pet.Description: He is a real trooper, faithfulling tagging along with Kojo for years. He enjoys hide and seek as well as some serious shell sliding.

Pet.Name: Carnivorous Lasher
Pet.Description: This horrific, flesh-eating plant promises it can make all of your wildest wishes come true. If you feed it.

Pet.Name: Azeriti
Pet.Description: A chip off the ol' girl's block. Azeriti is fiercely protective and will strike out against anyone wishing to do her mother harm.

Pet.Name: Fuzzy Creepling
Pet.Description: The young of Arathi Highlands' plains spiders may kick clouds of barbed abdomen hairs into predators' eyes. All this, and poisonous web-spitters, too.

Pet.Name: Aldrusian Sproutling
Pet.Description: So long as one of his Sproutlings remains, Branchlord Aldrus will never truly die.

Pet.Name: Voidwiggler
Pet.Description: Either Darbel Montrose was a terrible warlock, or she simply adored cute things. Perhaps both.

Pet.Name: Teeny Titan Orb
Pet.Description: Constructs designed to assist the titans with sundry small tasks, this example is oddly small. Teeny Titan Orb! Let's Go!

Pet.Name: Scabby
Pet.Description: While Yogursa managed to survive the blight infesting many of Hillsbrad's ursines, she was driven mad, and her cubs forever tainted.

Pet.Name: Ragepeep
Pet.Description: Part owl, part bear... and part stag, which handily avoids potential lawsuits.

Pet.Name: Foulfeather
Pet.Description: Plaguefeather and her brood feed well on the carrion the battle for Stromgarde has left scattered across the Highlands.

Pet.Name: Azerite Puddle
Pet.Description: These drops of Azerite are volatile and prone to explosive reactions when prodded.

Pet.Name: Fozling
Pet.Description: A living piece of Arathi's most infamous stone-faced behemoth, Fozruk.

Pet.Name: Squawkling
Pet.Description: Boulderfist legend recounts a cloud of carrion birds following ogre warriors through the Dark Portal during the Second War; it may be that all two-headed scavengers in Azeroth are their descendants.

Pet.Name: Lil' Siege Tower
Pet.Description: A mighty war machine of adorable proportions.

Pet.Name: Lil' War Machine
Pet.Description: A mighty war machine of adorable proportions.

Pet.Name: Scuttle
Pet.Description: Scuttle was named after the ships he destroys, not his movement patterns, and don't you forget it.

Pet.Name: Sparkleshell Sandcrawler
Pet.Description: The shells of this particular group of crabs shimmer like gems on the sand.

Pet.Name: Kindleweb Spiderling
Pet.Description: The kindleweb spider species is known amongst the island tribes for its warm, threadable webbing.

Pet.Name: Craghoof Kid
Pet.Description: The hooves of this subgroup of goats have evolved to be equally surefooted on sand or stone.

Pet.Name: False Knucklebump
Pet.Description: Someone put this mechanical gorilla on the island to monitor the species, but who, and why?

Pet.Name: Tinder Pup
Pet.Description: The only balls this hound chases are diamond-hard, fireproof rocks. Very heavy, not fun to throw.

Pet.Name: Bloodstone Tunneler
Pet.Description: Is that a venomous worm in your pocket or... why is that in your pocket?

Pet.Name: Poro
Pet.Description: Poro cannot fly, but enjoys a long lifespan hopping along the ground and shaking the fruits from trees.

Pet.Name: Juvenile Brineshell
Pet.Description: Even young brineshell are drawn to the line in the sky that meets the waves, it calls them.

Pet.Name: Kunchong Hatchling
Pet.Description: Based on the size, the mantid appear to be re-growing their swarm, likely due to the presence of a new empress.

Pet.Name: Captain Nibs
Pet.Description: Captain Nibs was once the leader of an ill-fated sea voyage of slightly-too-smart-for-their-own-good monkies that quickly capsized.

Pet.Name: Barnaby
Pet.Description: A wealthy pirate captain met with a strange man on the docks of an unknown city and bartered for everlasting life for his faithful companion. As with most monkey-related wishes, something went wrong.

Pet.Name: Coldlight Surfrunner
Pet.Description: The coldlight once were quite common across the oceans, to the grumbles of many hunters, but no longer.

Pet.Name: Muskflank Calfling
Pet.Description: Getting just one of these fragrant beasts damp is the olfactory equivalent to rolling around in a pile of wet dogs.

Pet.Name: Snort
Pet.Description: Particularly partial to coastal scrub grasses, this hardy species has survived many years in uncharted lands.

Pet.Name: Voru'kar Leecher
Pet.Description: The voru'kar are fiercely loyal to their leader, Vorus'arak, who led them to safety from the Lich King's grasp.

Pet.Name: Inky
Pet.Description: Whatever the story of his mysterious eyepatch is, he's not talking.

Pet.Name: Octopode Fry
Pet.Description: A baby octopode is technically referred to as a "squish."

Pet.Name: Sandshell Chitterer
Pet.Description: During the warm summer months, the noise that these pests make is enough to drive a person mad.

Pet.Name: Deathsting Scorpid
Pet.Description: It's sting is worse than... well nothing, really. Are you sure you want to keep this as a pet?

Pet.Name: Playful Frostkin
Pet.Description: You know how disappointing it is when you return to your beverage and the ice has all melted? This guy's fault.

Pet.Name: Giggling Flame
Pet.Description: The most nefarious of the trickster spirits, and the reason why the pandaren invented fireproof pants.

Pet.Name: Mischievous Zephyr
Pet.Description: "Beware the cool breeze, for it brings trickery." - pandaren proverb

Pet.Name: Laughing Stonekin
Pet.Description: The earth that's rumbling beneath your feet... is it quaking or laughing, or both?

Pet.Name: Thistlebrush Bud
Pet.Description: The sprites that inhabit the islands of the Great Sea have thought of many traps to lure in unwary visitors.

Pet.Name: Littlehoof
Pet.Description: Littlehoof likes: bounding, bouncing, frolicking, and headbutts, in that order.

Pet.Name: Snapper
Pet.Description: Wear gloves with this little guy, he loves to bite!

Pet.Name: Sunscale Hatchling
Pet.Description: The bright scales of this rare wind serpent soak up the sunlight to keep it warm, even in shade.

Pet.Name: Gearspring Hopper
Pet.Description: Mechanical Toads can hop over seven million times before their gears begin to wear out.

Pet.Name: Slippy
Pet.Description: These creatures are able to control each arm individually, which allows for great multi-tasking, and the ability to give the best hugs.

Pet.Name: Bloated Bloodfeaster
Pet.Description: The smallest of cuts can be devastating to this species, they start to leak all over the place.

Pet.Name: Baby Crawg
Pet.Description: The horns of a crawg grow at a tremendous rate starting almost immediately after they are born, and is among the hardest of natural materials found on a living species.

Pet.Name: Redridge Tarantula
Pet.Description: The tarantulas that inhabit southern Redridge are smaller than their cousins elsewhere in Azeroth, but make up for their size with speed and ferocity.

Pet.Name: Feathers
Pet.Description: Thought to be lost in a massive explosion, the smartest of engineers were able to rebuild Feathers into a magnificent mechanical creation.

Pet.Name: Child of Pa'ku
Pet.Description: There is a story told to some children that all winged creatures were unable to fly until Pa'ku provided enough wind to lift them off of the ground.

Pet.Name: Spawn of Krag'wa
Pet.Description: A toad with Krag'wa's bloodline has an average expectancy to leap over seven million times during its lifetime.

Pet.Name: Thunder Lizard Runt
Pet.Description: The large plates on the back of this lizard are made of a mysterious but highly conductive material, making it ideal to charge up and expel massive amounts of electricity.

Pet.Name: Mechantula
Pet.Description: The Mechantula was created by an unknown gnomish Engineer. Rumor has it when the original schematic was found, it was in a room covered with dusty old webbing, but neither the original Mechantula or the engineer who drafted the schematic could be found.

Pet.Name: Mechanical Cockroach
Pet.Description: Mechanical Cockroaches are less likely to survive an apocalypse than an actual living cockroach, making this one of the more questionable feats of engineering.

Pet.Name: Leper Rat
Pet.Description: The radiation from all of the machinery in Gnomeregan gives these rats a soft green glow when looked at in absolute darkness.

Pet.Name: Alarm-O-Dog
Pet.Description: The Alarm-O-Dog was built for security purposes, but people really wanted one for their home because they are so darn cute.

Pet.Name: Dasher
Pet.Description: Like many other species, you can get a rough guess of how large the raptor will be as a fully grown adult by the size of its largest claw.

Pet.Name: Trecker
Pet.Description: One of the earliest recorded victories in a large battle on Zandalar depicted mighty warriors riding into battle on armored raptors. The legend has it that the warrior did not choose their raptor, but that the raptor would choose the warrior.

Pet.Name: Tanzil
Pet.Description: During certain times of the day, the sunlight can cause a reflection on the feathers of the red tinted raptors causing them to look more like flames than feathers.

Pet.Name: Darkshore Sentinel
Pet.Description: The Sentinel Owls of Darkshore are forever protective of their homeland.

Pet.Name: Gust of Cyclarus
Pet.Description: When Cyclarus came to Darkshore, small cyclones appeared all over the place. Some of them dissipated over time, others found their way back to Cyclarus and were absorbed into the surrounding winds.

Pet.Name: Detective Ray
Pet.Description: This is what happens when you try to one-up Pip Quickwit's tall tales of being stuck inside of dangerous creatures.

Pet.Name: Hydrath Droplet
Pet.Description: Hydrath Water Droplets are also an excellent skin moisturizer.

Pet.Name: Everburning Treant
Pet.Description: A lone Ancient of Lore in Darnassus managed to save this Treant in its final actions with a magical aura to prevent the flames from burning it any further.

Pet.Name: Void Jelly
Pet.Description: This Jelly has seen better days. Now it sees through fifty different eyes.

Pet.Name: Zur'aj the Depleted
Pet.Description: Once a mighty warrior of the n'raqi, Zur'aj's power was stolen and absorbed by an unknown rival.

Pet.Name: Baby Stonehide
Pet.Description: The playful kicks of these baby moose are enough to knock an orc flat on his back.

Pet.Name: Leatherwing Screecher
Pet.Description: We don't know much about this species, but we do know this: bats aren't bugs.

Pet.Name: Rotting Ghoul
Pet.Description: Get it while it lasts.

Pet.Name: Needleback Pup
Pet.Description: The needleback porcupines have survived life in island climates by evolving to be extra lucky.

Pet.Name: Albino Duskwatcher
Pet.Description: Albino ravens are incredibly rare and highly prized amongst the traders of the Great Sea.

Pet.Name: Shadefeather Hatchling
Pet.Description: Though barely a hatchling, its claws are already sharp enough to pierce the flesh of many smaller critters.

Pet.Name: Firesting Buzzer
Pet.Description: Firesting wasps are said to have one of the worst bites of any wasp species, causing a pain like a burning blaze.

Pet.Name: Lord Woofington
Pet.Description: Lord Woofington was given his title after the rest of the denizens of Havenswood succumbed to madness.
