Pet.Name: Tonguelasher
Pet.Description: It has one solution to all of its problems: give em' a lashing.

Pet.Name: Scritches
Pet.Description: Key activities include: rolling over, sunning self, whimpering for belly scratches, and enjoying belly scratches.

Pet.Name: Thunderscale Whelpling
Pet.Description: These whelps are frequently captured by the denizens of Jorundall when still young and trainable.

Pet.Name: Crimson Octopode
Pet.Description: The crimson species of octopode grows larger and hardier than others, and is capable of sustaining crushing pressure in the depths.

Pet.Name: Nightwreathed Watcher
Pet.Description: It is an honor in the Sentinel Army to be entrusted with the care of an owl born from the boughs of the great tree Teldrassil.

Pet.Name: Rebuilt Gorilla Bot
Pet.Description: The convenient part of robots that fight each other is that you can just put them back together. Step two is to attach a giant laser cannon to ensure you win the next battle.

Pet.Name: Rebuilt Mechanical Spider
Pet.Description: Anyone serious about using a mechanical spider in battle knows that you need to buy replacement legs in bulk. Those things are fragile.

Pet.Name: Albatross Hatchling
Pet.Description: The Albatross is capable of flying further than any other species of bird on all of Azeroth.

Pet.Name: Crimson Bat Pup
Pet.Description: Unlike most other bat species, the crimson bats are actually blind and rely entirely on echolocation to get around.

Pet.Name: Cobalt Raven
Pet.Description: The feathers of the cobalt raven glow eerily in the moonlight, making them easy to spot during the night.

Pet.Name: Violet Abyssal Eel
Pet.Description: The Abyssal Eels are able to swallow and digest something up to twice the width of their body.

Pet.Name: Mr. Crabs
Pet.Description: Mr. Crabs was victorious in a lengthy brawl amongst nearly a dozen other hermit crabs to claim his current shell.

Pet.Name: Beakbert
Pet.Description: Beakbert's favorite food is a ravenberry.

Pet.Name: Froglet
Pet.Description: The skin of a teal frog sometimes shimmers just right in the sunlight, providing excellent camouflage when on the surface of the water.

Pet.Name: Scaley
Pet.Description: Saurolisk scales are a surprisingly flexible but durable material that are often used to reinforce or mend things that are broken or worn through.

Pet.Name: Stoneclaw
Pet.Description: Quilen were the favored companions of the ancient Mogu race due to their loyal nature.

Pet.Name: Wayward Spirit
Pet.Description: Crossing into the spirit world too often can be dangerous for your health.

Pet.Name: Comet
Pet.Description: The Engine of Nalak'sha is defended by many mighty beings, and many tiny beings.

Pet.Name: Baoh-Xi
Pet.Description: For being an inanimate object for many centuries, this statue sure moves around really well.

Pet.Name: Azure Windseeker
Pet.Description: This little cloud serpent's favorite activity is chasing its own tail.

Pet.Name: Spirit of the Spring
Pet.Description: The elemental spirits of Pandaria have been known to plan tricks to play on unsuspecting visitors years in advance.

Pet.Name: Kor'thik Swarmling
Pet.Description: Don't let these eat after midnight, legend has it that it's very dangerous.

Pet.Name: Amberglow Stinger
Pet.Description: The glow eminating from these is both calming and eerie at the same time when in total darkness.

Pet.Name: Spawn of Garalon
Pet.Description: The kunchong are extremely aggressive and will eat just about anything they can as soon as they are able to walk. If they can't eat it, they will smash it instead.

Pet.Name: Living Amber
Pet.Description: The mantid are extremely reliant upon amber for many things, and even use it in some of their magic.

Pet.Name: Ravenous Prideling
Pet.Description: As a spawn of the most dangerous sha, this little monster has some big plans, but needs to wait a few thousand years first.

Pet.Name: Zanj'ir Poker
Pet.Description: Master of poking, stabbing, thrusting, jabbing, and gouging.

Pet.Name: Murgle
Pet.Description: The murloc tribe that Murgle belongs to is one of few that have resisted the naga's enslavement.

Pet.Name: Necrofin Tadpole
Pet.Description: Legend has it that the Necrofin tribe found necromancy on a series of runed tablets at the bottom of the sea.

Pet.Name: Glittering Diamondshell
Pet.Description: A rare species of crab found mostly in Nazjatar, it hides easily amongst the ample kelp and coral of the area.

Pet.Name: Sandclaw Nestseeker
Pet.Description: Anything can be a nest, if you try hard enough.

Pet.Name: Pearlescent Glimmershell
Pet.Description: When the sun shines on its shell just right, the light scatters in a thousand different directions.

Pet.Name: Chitterspine Needler
Pet.Description: A rare evolution of chitterspine, with elongated spines to pierce soft flesh and eyes.

Pet.Name: Caverndark Nightmare
Pet.Description: As if a dark, underwater cave wasn't nightmarish enough, these things exist -- and they love it there.

Pet.Name: Chitterspine Devourer
Pet.Description: These gruesome crabs are attracted to the scent of blood and seem to revel in combat.

Pet.Name: Lightless Ambusher
Pet.Description: In the lightless caverns, a bright shell color doesn't make you any worse at ambushing.

Pet.Name: Spawn of Nalaada
Pet.Description: In a dark place unknown to all, the seabed writhes with the children of Nalaada, a carpet of life and death.

Pet.Name: Mindlost Bloodfrenzy
Pet.Description: In the fathomless depths beyond the Eternal Palace, minds are lost in the blackness.

Pet.Name: Daggertooth Frenzy
Pet.Description: Frenzies in Nazjatar have learned to operate in large schools or face consumption by the many predators of the deeps.

Pet.Name: Nameless Octopode
Pet.Description: The influence of the old gods on the aquatic life of Nazjatar is unmistakable, as many simply wander as mindless eyes of N'zoth.

Pet.Name: Amethyst Softshell
Pet.Description: Spireshells produce a softer shell when young which will be grown out of quickly.

Pet.Name: Prismatic Softshell
Pet.Description: Even with its softer juvenile shell, a young prismatic spireshell still glitters like a diamond.

Pet.Name: Damplight Slug
Pet.Description: The bright coloration of this deep water slug seems to give off a soft, warm glow.

Pet.Name: Wriggler
Pet.Description: Watch your ears.

Pet.Name: Seafury
Pet.Description: The elements clash and battle for relics constantly, but few moreso than the Tidestone.

Pet.Name: Stormwrath
Pet.Description: The Tidestone would empower minions of both the storm and the sea, and is sought after by both parties.

Pet.Name: Sandkeep
Pet.Description: This pile of animated sand is fun to squish between your fingers, but doesn't really like it when you do that.

Pet.Name: Scalebrood Hydra
Pet.Description: The hydra matriarchs of Nazjatar steal and destroy one another's eggs constantly, so you can never really know what will hatch out of one.

Pet.Name: Brinestone Algan
Pet.Description: Standing next to a brinestone algan will remind you of the smell of the sea, mixed with rotting kelp.

Pet.Name: Budding Algan
Pet.Description: There's no mistaking the evidence -- algan breed by budding. We can all put this argument to rest now.

Pet.Name: Coral Lashling
Pet.Description: The predatory coral of Nazjatar can grow incredibly quickly given the right conditions.

Pet.Name: Skittering Eel
Pet.Description: The eels of Nazjatar are experts at hiding in the many cracks and rocks of the sea floor.

Pet.Name: Drowned Hatchling
Pet.Description: When the waves crashed down around the city, not all were fortunate enough to receive N'zoth's gift.

Pet.Name: Golden Snorf
Pet.Description: The birth of an exceptionally rare Golden Snorf was such an abnormality that not even King Mechagon could force himself to mechanize his beloved, fuzzy friend.

Pet.Name: Snowsoft Nibbler
Pet.Description: Of all snooters, this one has the softest fur. Ironically, it does not like to be pet very much.

Pet.Name: Mustyfur Snooter
Pet.Description: A rare snooter, and hard to find, it's known for burrowing itself deep under wet foliage to nest.

Pet.Name: OOX-35/MG
Pet.Description: Many advancements have been made to the initial prototype homing beacon over the years.

Pet.Name: Lost Robogrip
Pet.Description: It's not clear who the original owner of this arm was, but they're not getting it back now.

Pet.Name: Utility Mechanoclaw
Pet.Description: As handy as this invention is, it was also programmed to absolutely despise hand puns.

Pet.Name: Microbot XD
Pet.Description: One of the microbots used to guard the city of Rustbolt, now purchasable for a reasonable price.

Pet.Name: Microbot 8D
Pet.Description: He's just so happy to be programmed to exist.

Pet.Name: Bonebiter
Pet.Description: Absolutely do not let him bite your bones.

Pet.Name: Arachnoid Skitterbot
Pet.Description: No one knows who made these mechanical spiders, but everyone hates them.

Pet.Name: Echoing Oozeling
Pet.Description: It doesn't take a very large ooze to eat a gnome.

Pet.Name: Spraybot 0D
Pet.Description: Even he cannot put out the fire in my heart.

Pet.Name: Ghostly Whelpling
Pet.Description: Unkillable dragons, what could go wrong?

Pet.Name: Adventurous Hopling
Pet.Description: The last thing that tried to look in its tiny pack was never seen again.

Pet.Name: Irradiated Elementaling
Pet.Description: In case of darkness, this little elemental is an infinite source of a soothing green glow.

Pet.Name: Slimy Otter
Pet.Description: The slimy coating on this otter provides excellent protection against sunburns.

Pet.Name: Slimy Eel
Pet.Description: Eels are already slimy. This one is extra slimy.

Pet.Name: Slimy Octopode
Pet.Description: This little octopode squirts slime out instead of ink.

Pet.Name: Slimy Fangtooth
Pet.Description: A fully grown Fangtooth has a bite strong enough to go right through a platinum fishing pole. Watch your fingers.

Pet.Name: Slimy Darkhunter
Pet.Description: Living so deep within the seas has made this species very sensitive to lights.

Pet.Name: Slimy Hermit Crab
Pet.Description: The slime on this provides essential nutrients to the hermit crab within, allowing it to go years without eating anything if it chooses.

Pet.Name: Slimy Sea Slug
Pet.Description: Slimy sea slugs secrete slimy sea slug slime on the slimy sea floor.

Pet.Name: Armored Vaultbot
Pet.Description: A walking vault that throws its money at you is not a very secure vault to own.

Pet.Name: Papi
Pet.Description: Legend has it that these purple butterflies came from a place called Devil's Island.

Pet.Name: Sunsoaked Flitter
Pet.Description: The wings of this butterfly start off with no distinct color, but slowly change to yellow as they spend time in the sunlight.

Pet.Name: Crimson Skipper
Pet.Description: This butterfly is stained red from the blood of its enemies.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Toad
Pet.Description: Pulled from a horrific vision of Orgrimmar these toads are soaked in void energy.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Pup
Pet.Description: This pup is now more than just a bundle of fur and teeth, it is fur, teeth and void.

Pet.Name: Plagueborn Slime
Pet.Description: In Maldraxxus, plague has a strange habit of finding its way back to you.

Pet.Name: Muar
Pet.Description: The thirst for mana is insatiable, luckily this little one doesn't consume a whole lot.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Anubisath
Pet.Description: N'Zoth's corruption spread across many beings, including this little Anubisath.

Pet.Name: Aqir Hivespawn
Pet.Description: The aqir hive has countless numbers of beings in it, all of which are supportive of the ever-present Hivemind.

Pet.Name: Ra'kim
Pet.Description: The winged aqir are very fast and agile, and their wings provide a nice breeze on a warm afternoon.

Pet.Name: Eye of Corruption
Pet.Description: This creepy eye is looking at everyone, always, and only has to blink once every 10,000 years.

Pet.Name: Gloop
Pet.Description: It is very unclear whether this slime started with all of those eyes inside of it, or if those are "leftovers".

Pet.Name: C'Thuffer
Pet.Description: It is always C'Thuffer. Always.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Hare
Pet.Description: Only a being of immense power could scar such an adorable creature, unless this hare was already approaching the darkness...

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Cat
Pet.Description: This cat eats anything from random scraps of food to strange glowing cubes of immense power. Be careful in front of its mouth.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Rat
Pet.Description: A recent debate has risen up about whether Void-Scarred rats are better or worse than plagued rats.

Pet.Name: Anomalus
Pet.Description: This ooze leaves behind a slimy trail as it moves that has a stench that would rival a beast rotting in the dunes of Uldum for a thousand years.

Pet.Name: Void-Scarred Beetle
Pet.Description: The shell on these beetles is quite brittle from the void interference, but it also has a strangely fast regeneration rate.

Pet.Name: K'uddly
Pet.Description: His tentacles give you the best hug your brain has ever felt.

Pet.Name: Corrupted Tentacle
Pet.Description: Where did it come from, where does it go? Where did you come from, creepy tentacle?

Pet.Name: Rotbreath
Pet.Description: Dragonbreath Chili is nothing compared to the stench coming from the mouth of this thing.

Pet.Name: Aqir Tunneler
Pet.Description: These Aqir Scarabs are masters at tunneling through any terrain.

Pet.Name: Pygmy Camel
Pet.Description: These Pygmy Camels are often mistaken for Mysterious Camel Figurines.

Pet.Name: Cursed Dune Watcher
Pet.Description: This little guy was exiled and cursed by other watchers of Uldum to spend the rest of its time as a tiny insignificant being.

Pet.Name: Wicked Lurker
Pet.Description: Three legs, two arms, three eyeballs, the extras are for emergency situations only.

Pet.Name: Jade Defender
Pet.Description: Several adventurous miners have gone after the jade quilen in search of riches, but none have ever been heard from again.

Pet.Name: Windfeather Chick
Pet.Description: Despite what the young pandaren may tell you, the windfeather cranes do not actually have feathers made out of wind.

Pet.Name: PHA7-YNX
Pet.Description: Inspired by the phalynx of Bastion, Engineers have modified the design to be approximately 300% more adorable.

Pet.Name: Blushing Spiderling
Pet.Description: The crypts and tombs of Revendreth offer the perfect spider breeding ground, and Tomb Burster's brood has become fiercely territorial of their foothold.

Pet.Name: Bound Lightspawn
Pet.Description: Lightspawn can always be found on the battlefields where light touches, no matter what form it takes.

Pet.Name: Animated Tome
Pet.Description: Beware awakening the power of knowledge.

Pet.Name: Burdened Soul
Pet.Description: A soul burdened with the sins of its past.

Pet.Name: Primordial Bogling
Pet.Description: The sludge that can give rise to the dredgers has been known to coalesce and run a muck.

Pet.Name: Wrathling
Pet.Description: Drawn from an overabundance of pride and wrath these manifestations seek even more to sustain themselves.

Pet.Name: Raw Emotion
Pet.Description: These creatures manifest in the catacombs beneath Revendreth due to vile rituals practiced on souls there.

Pet.Name: Court Messenger
Pet.Description: The stone fiends were created to serve as messengers and spies for the realm of Revendreth, and those of the Court of Harvesters serve that role extremely well.

Pet.Name: Dal
Pet.Description: A fellow message courier to Chip, Dal was always on time until one day when he did not return from his appointed round.

Pet.Name: Trapped Stonefiend
Pet.Description: Trapped in a chest and forgotten for years, this stone fiend is mad and looking for a fight.

Pet.Name: Crimson Dredwing Pup
Pet.Description: A wild dredbat, the crimson pups are tough to tame. Their elusiveness and hardiness set them apart from their kin.

Pet.Name: Violet Dredwing Pup
Pet.Description: A rare mutation gives this dredbat its violet underbelly, making it a sought after gift for pet collectors with eclectic tastes.

Pet.Name: Dodger
Pet.Description: Dodger is a bit small relative to other vulpin, but is excellent at playing hide and seek.

Pet.Name: Rocky
Pet.Description: The claws of a vulpin sharpen themselves naturally when walking around on any sort of cobblestone or rocky surface.

Pet.Name: Chirpy Valeshrieker
Pet.Description: Despite the adorable name, the chirp is more of a horrible, spine-tingling shriek.

Pet.Name: Cloudfeather Fledgling
Pet.Description: These ferocious flying creatures scrape their beaks against hard surfaces to sharpen them and intimidate foes.

Pet.Name: Floofa
Pet.Description: Floofa smells like citrus fruits when its fur is wet.

Pet.Name: Amber Glitterwing
Pet.Description: Much like how a squid can squirt ink to escape in the water, a glitterwing can shake the dust off of its wings and similarly vanish.

Pet.Name: Dusty Sporeflutterer
Pet.Description: The moths of Ardenweald can carry seeds and pods many times their own weight, aiding the Night Fae in their eternal tasks.

Pet.Name: Fuzzy Shimmermoth
Pet.Description: Shimmermoths don't actually shimmer in the sunlight. Nobody knows who named these, but they have a lot to answer for.

Pet.Name: Starry Dreamfoal
Pet.Description: When a full moon is visible, streaks of hair on the dreamfoal's mane start to shimmer and glow like shooting stars.

Pet.Name: Willowbreeze
Pet.Description: When the winds blow just right, howling through the canyons of Ardenweald, you can find these foals running with the wind in a spectacular show of prowess and color.

Pet.Name: Hungry Burrower
Pet.Description: While these gormlings may not be the fastest diggers, they are very efficient and can move long distances underground before tiring.

Pet.Name: Gloober, as G'huun
Pet.Description: Even the terrifying G'huun was, perhaps, once this cute.

Pet.Name: Grubby
Pet.Description: These little slugs will try to eat literally anything they scoot over.

Pet.Name: Gorm Needler
Pet.Description: There are more sharp pointy things on this species of gorm than there are on a Horde capital city.

Pet.Name: Gorm Harrier
Pet.Description: If you count the number of times its wings beat per minute, you can calculate how long it will be until this little terror will sting you.

Pet.Name: Devouring Animite
Pet.Description: No one knows where the devourers came from, but it is theorized that they flourish on several lost land masses in the In-Between.

Pet.Name: Pearlwing Heron
Pet.Description: The whooping noise these pets make when hungry will rival any tormented cry you can find in Torghast.

Pet.Name: Golden Cloudfeather
Pet.Description: A group of teroclaws is known as a fleece.

Pet.Name: Helpful Glimmerfly
Pet.Description: A glimmerfly can load up nearly fifty percent of its weight as pollen and still retain full agility while flying.

Pet.Name: Brightscale Hatchling
Pet.Description: These brightly-colored terrapins are the least commonly seen in the wild. It is considered a sign of luck if you rub the top of its shell.

Pet.Name: Silvershell Snapper
Pet.Description: Terrapins prefer any sort of berry as their primary source of food, though they will eat almost anything.

Pet.Name: Sable
Pet.Description: Vulpin actually have very light-colored skin, but their incredibly thick coats hide any color from showing through.

Pet.Name: Goldenpaw Kit
Pet.Description: The golden vulpin are notorious for loud, barking yowls that echo across the plains of Bastion.

Pet.Name: Purity
Pet.Description: Despite having a very fine coat of fur, young vulpin do not shed at all.

Pet.Name: Gilded Wader
Pet.Description: These golden-feathered creatures do not lay golden eggs, for that you would need a golden goose.

Pet.Name: Devoured Wader
Pet.Description: When newly-hatched, they start with colorless, white feathers. Within weeks, they flourish into a wide spectrum of beautiful colors.

Pet.Name: Indigo
Pet.Description: The mane on this tiny foal reflects a majestic indigo color when the light hits it in just the right way.

Pet.Name: Spirited Skyfoal
Pet.Description: Few things are as adorable as a young skyfoal.

Pet.Name: Oonar's Arm
Pet.Description: The thrill of battle and the grip of war have not yet left the bones of Oonar.

Pet.Name: Corpulent Bonetusk
Pet.Description: A newborn bonetusk has no visible tusks, but within weeks their tusks grow to a size proportional to their body.

Pet.Name: Pernicious Bonetusk
Pet.Description: The tusks on these creatures are fused to their skulls in such a manner that they feel no pain when charging or ramming into anything.

Pet.Name: Luminous Webspinner
Pet.Description: The bright color of the luminous webspinner taunts would-be predators to chase them into their webs.

Pet.Name: Boneweave Hatchling
Pet.Description: Maldraxxus is full of mighty and terrifying creatures, causing most denizens to be abnormally calm when around the indigenous species of giant spiders.

Pet.Name: Skittering Venomspitter
Pet.Description: If this species spits venom at its prey, is it still technically considered venom, or just really gross?

Pet.Name: Bubbling Pustule
Pet.Description: The bubbles inside of these ooze creatures make a very satisfying pop noise when they finally surface and rupture.

Pet.Name: Shy Melvin
Pet.Description: One of Plague Deviser Marileth's first creations, Shy Melvin was too timid for the demands placed on slimes by the House of Plagues.

Pet.Name: Plaguelouse Larva
Pet.Description: A parasite that latches onto some of the larger beasts of Maldraxxus and drinks until fully-grown, one wonders how the beasts don't manage to notice.

Pet.Name: Corpselouse Larva
Pet.Description: Though they are quite squishy while young, the bloodlouse will eventually grow hardened plates around its entire body.

Pet.Name: Feasting Larva
Pet.Description: Being thrown into a pit of bloodlouse larvae is a painful fate for those that fail the great houses of Maldraxxus.

Pet.Name: Writhing Spine
Pet.Description: Some predators in Maldraxxus collect spines as trophies, and some of them don't stop moving even then.

Pet.Name: Backbone
Pet.Description: What it lacks in appendages, it makes up for in positive attitude.

Pet.Name: Micromancer
Pet.Description: Even the smallest bones don't go to waste in Maldraxxus.

Pet.Name: Invertebrate Oil
Pet.Description: Is the ooze holding the bones in, or are the bones holding the ooze together?

Pet.Name: Sludge Feeler
Pet.Description: It is not advisable to hug a sludge feeler. Those stains never wash out.

Pet.Name: Toenail
Pet.Description: If you can beat them, stitch them!

Pet.Name: Mu'dud
Pet.Description: The soul that occupies Mu'dud was a harsh ruler in life, and now he seeks to dominate the most violent kingdom of all.

Pet.Name: Foulwing Buzzer
Pet.Description: The barbed mandibles on this species will dig deep into anything they bite, causing a lot of irritation.

Pet.Name: Bloodfeaster Spiderling
Pet.Description: Unlike most spiders that drain all the fluids from their prey, the bloodfeaster has developed a taste for blood alone.

Pet.Name: Stoneskin Dredwing Pup
Pet.Description: These dredbats are built by the Stonewright for the Court of Harvesters. They are bonded to their owners and become fierce fighters.

Pet.Name: Lost Quill
Pet.Description: No longer lost, it's now considering a name change.

Pet.Name: The Count
Pet.Description: Roosting in the grounds of Castle Nathria, The Count did not foresee falling into an eternal stone slumber.

Pet.Name: Sinfall Screecher
Pet.Description: Joining with their new residents in Sinfall a few of these juvenile dredbats accompanied Renathal's forces into the maw.

Pet.Name: Battie
Pet.Description: Roosting over Sinfall, Battie was roused one evening by the music of the first Ember Court. She has not missed a single one since.

Pet.Name: Stony
Pet.Description: Abandoned by its master in a secluded room, the little bat has been hibernating in stone for ages.

Pet.Name: Bloodlouse Larva
Pet.Description: What vile subtance is jiggling around inside of this creature?

Pet.Name: Fun Guss
Pet.Description: This particular tiny tree is infested with strange spores and doesn't seem to mind.

Pet.Name: Leafadore
Pet.Description: These saplings grow unnaturally quickly when given enough anima, and their leaves are razor sharp when fully grown.

Pet.Name: Stemmins
Pet.Description: Whatever you do, don't ask it to carry a bucket of water. We don't talk about what happened to that area of the Shadowlands.

Pet.Name: Runelight Leaper
Pet.Description: This pet has tremendous airborne agility and will always land on its feet, even when flung by a home-made spring-loaded leaper-flinger.

Pet.Name: Shimmerbough Hoarder
Pet.Description: These critters are capable of holding a tremendous amount of food in their cheeks for easy transportation between hiding spaces.

Pet.Name: Sir Reginald
Pet.Description: No one is quite sure where Reginald got his or her name, but what we do know is they don't answer to anything else.

Pet.Name: Char
Pet.Description: The skies may have scorched part of Revendreth, but persistent creatures are still able to exist in these harsh conditions.

Pet.Name: Carpal
Pet.Description: Nobody knows why all of these skeletal hands are from the left hand. Where did the right hands go?

Pet.Name: Tower Deathroach
Pet.Description: Torghast is a tower of hardship and perpetual agony, which is a perfect environment for these creatures.

Pet.Name: Hissing Deathroach
Pet.Description: Many have asked where these creatures came from, and how they made it to the Maw, but none that researched them have ever been heard from again.

Pet.Name: Severs
Pet.Description: If a detached hand claps by itself inside of Torghast, can the Jailer hear it?

Pet.Name: Maw Crawler
Pet.Description: The mysterious forces that animate this mobile mitt don't seem particularly evil, yet.

Pet.Name: Ashen Chomper
Pet.Description: Sometimes it is best to leave what strange creature you found in a mysterious jar in the depths of Torghast alone.

Pet.Name: Frenzied Mawrat
Pet.Description: Its teeth are razor sharp and will chew through just about anything.

Pet.Name: Maw Stalker
Pet.Description: These guardians of Torghast are always watching for suspicious activity.

Pet.Name: Torghast Lurker
Pet.Description: That eerie feeling you get when the shadows seem to shift and follow you isn't just a feeling, it's usually one of these.

Pet.Name: Lavender Nibbler
Pet.Description: Poking a tiny gormlng in the side makes a very satisfying, squishy noise. It is NOT advisable to poke one too many times.

Pet.Name: Dread
Pet.Description: Staring at one of these creates a deep void of emotion at the very core of your being, then fills it with a sense of dread.

Pet.Name: Undying Deathroach
Pet.Description: This species has a very distinct set of markings on its back that makes it easy to identify in the unending horrors of the Maw.

Pet.Name: Decaying Mawrat
Pet.Description: Tiny flakes of skin seem to perpetually fall off of this horrible creature, leaving behind a trail and a very distinct, foul odor.

Pet.Name: Sharpclaw
Pet.Description: The razor sharp claws will tear into anything with ease, making for an excellent emergency can opener.

Pet.Name: Spinemaw Gormling
Pet.Description: While young, they have an adorable face and cute little antennae. While grown up, they gain razor sharp pinchers and are unstoppable eating machines. Life is full of compromises.

Pet.Name: Iridescent Ooze
Pet.Description: This slime seems to change color the more you look at it, and then suddenly, it appears to be looking back at you. Perhaps it is time for a rest.

Pet.Name: Putrid Geist
Pet.Description: Despite being decrepit and undead, geists move with exceptional speed and agility.

Pet.Name: Spinebug
Pet.Description: You got spinebugged!

Pet.Name: Archivist's Quill
Pet.Description: A good friend to Archivist Fane since his earliest days, Janeera is ready for him to let the quill go as she feels he is getting too attached.

Pet.Name: Steward Featherling
Pet.Description: Stewards looking to move up in steward society know to fluff up their feathers, give out tons of juice, and always be hooting.

Pet.Name: Lost Featherling
Pet.Description: Tales say that the stewards were created to aid the denizens of Bastion in their eternal duties. They don't seem to mind.

Pet.Name: Larion Pouncer
Pet.Description: Larion are prideful beasts, and see anyone that enters their territory as a challenge.

Pet.Name: Larion Cub
Pet.Description: When fully-grown, a larion that has grown up with an aspirant will never leave his or her master's side.

Pet.Name: Courage
Pet.Description: Young larions are often given to aspirants as an early test of compassion and leadership.

Pet.Name: Lucy
Pet.Description: Lucy was sent to Revendreth, as all cats are, and somehow escaped. When questioned, local dredgers blamed it on her being a cat.

Pet.Name: Squibbles
Pet.Description: Squibbles is engineered to never leave your side.

Pet.Name: Flawless Amethyst Baubleworm
Pet.Description: Baubleworms are highly prized in the Veiled Market, where those featuring few gemstone flaws can fetch extreme prices.

Pet.Name: Lil'Abom
Pet.Description: The fields of battle teem with Lil'Abom parts, which are perfectly interchangable and easy to put back together.

Pet.Name: Infused Etherwyrm
Pet.Description: Infused etherwyrms can be used as portable anima batteries, but they must be trained not to flee at the sight of combat.

Pet.Name: Timeless Mechanical Dragonling
Pet.Description: Dragons come in all types of temporal classification -- timeless, time-lost, and even infinite.

Pet.Name: Sly
Pet.Description: Sly snuck aboard for a trip into the Maw. He's not scared, he just really wants to stay in your backpack for a while.

Pet.Name: Copperback Etherwyrm
Pet.Description: The brilliant scales of the etherwyrm reflect the bright skies of Bastion.

Pet.Name: Ruby Baubleworm
Pet.Description: The gemstones on a baubleworm will quickly deteriorate if the worm is killed. Healthy worms are kept as prized pets by wealthy Brokers.

Pet.Name: Turquoise Baubleworm
Pet.Description: Baubleworms were found by the Brokers on an unknown world, and so gorgeous were their gems, that quickly the expedition turned against one another.

Pet.Name: Topaz Baubleworm
Pet.Description: Baubleworms have no natural predators, and grow their gemstones to attract mates.

Pet.Name: Gizmo
Pet.Description: Gizmo is considered a perfect purrkin, perhaps the best that has ever existed. He is also a ruthless murderer of small critters.

Pet.Name: Rarity
Pet.Description: One particular Broker has taken a liking to the skrat species, kept this rare specimin as a pet, and inherited the smell as a souvenir.

Pet.Name: Fodder
Pet.Description: When you're a Maldraxxian stitchcrafter and you have to name a lot of abominations, sometimes you just go with the obvious choice.

Pet.Name: Invasive Buzzer
Pet.Description: Gorm find a way to invade just about anywhere, and the Maw is no exception.

Pet.Name: Amaranthine Stinger
Pet.Description: Though the spawn of a gorm queen lost within the Maw, this pet appears to be untainted by the Jailer's foul magics.

Pet.Name: Grappling Gauntlet
Pet.Description: Struggle all you want, it will just grip harder.

Pet.Name: Irongrasp
Pet.Description: There was once a mawsworn so vile that he was killed by his own minions. So great was his malice that a fragment of him lives on in this glove.

Pet.Name: Golden Eye
Pet.Description: See reflections on the water? There's more than darkness in the depths.

Pet.Name: Chompy
Pet.Description: One of several indistinguishable pets, all named Chompy.

Pet.Name: Eye of Allseeing
Pet.Description: The Eye of the Jailer, diffused, is now merely an all-seeing magical bauble.

Pet.Name: Eye of Extermination
Pet.Description: The rage Zovaal harbored for his punished existence echoes through the eye.

Pet.Name: Gilded Darknight
Pet.Description: The golden armor on these mawsworn is flimsy and easily bent -- the gilded armor is a punishment.

Pet.Name: Mawsworn Minion
Pet.Description: The Sanctum of Domination accepts mawsworn of all shapes, sizes, and levels of corporeality.

Pet.Name: Rook
Pet.Description: Rook never speaks, and little about them is known.

Pet.Name: Korthian Specimen
Pet.Description: With Korthia torn asunder by the Jailer, the few species that remain must be archived.

Pet.Name: Mosscoated Gromit
Pet.Description: The hide color of this species is more rare on Korthia, and helps it hide from predators. And mawsworn, in this case.

Pet.Name: Domestic Aunian
Pet.Description: A domesticated species, it is quite calm and seems hungry.

Pet.Name: Gnashtooth
Pet.Description: It only has two teeth, and they both mean business.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Focus
Pet.Description: One part focus, one part core, zero parts coherent or stable shape.

Pet.Name: Resonant Echo
Pet.Description: The core of a song that all but faded long ago.

Pet.Name: Omnipotential Core
Pet.Description: It could become anything. It could become *everything*. In the meantime, it's... this.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Discovery
Pet.Description: One part facial sphere, one part cube manufactory, one part successful curiosity.

Pet.Name: Tunneling Vombata
Pet.Description: Only newly synthesized tunneling vombata have been seen. The rest are probably happily digging underground, never to be seen again.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Motion
Pet.Description: One part beak, two parts wings, one part inability to stop, one part unwillingness to stop.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Animation
Pet.Description: One part rocks, two parts bigger rocks, three parts smaller rocks, one part ability to move anyway.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Serenity
Pet.Description: One part slippery skin, one part powerful legs, one part vocal sac, one part complete self-acceptance.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Multiplicity
Pet.Description: One part duplication, two parts duplication, four parts duplication... oops.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Metamorphosis
Pet.Description: One part gills, one part haste, one part whatever it needs to be.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Predation
Pet.Description: Eight parts legs. Eight parts eyes. One part rope. One part insatiable hunger.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Survival
Pet.Description: One part shell. One part claw. As many parts resilience as need be.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Cunning
Pet.Description: Three parts planning, one part danger, one part noodle.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Malice
Pet.Description: Two parts wings, one part dagger, five parts sadism.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Satisfaction
Pet.Description: Two parts wings, one part beak, two parts talon, one part smugness.

Pet.Name: Shelly
Pet.Description: Isn't she just the sweetest little helicid?

Pet.Name: Ambystan Darter
Pet.Description: Ambystans are swift but cowardly creatures. At the first hint of danger, a darter will hide in the nearest hole.

Pet.Name: Fierce Scarabid
Pet.Description: The red coloring on this scarabid lets potential opponents know it is not to be trifled with.

Pet.Name: Violent Poultrid
Pet.Description: These poultrids are hostile, but never angry. They love every moment of every battle.

Pet.Name: Multichicken
Pet.Description: It's really unclear what's 'multi' about them.

Pet.Name: Stabilized Geomental
Pet.Description: Lihuvim's geomental creations are the most majestic of walking rock piles.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Renewal
Pet.Description: Just one part jelly, but refreshed over and over and over again.

Pet.Name: Terror Jelly
Pet.Description: It feeds on fear, but is generally too cute to inspire terror on its own.

Pet.Name: Prototickles
Pet.Description: This creature's existence strongly implies the existence of other, more advanced tickle-based aurelids out there.

Pet.Name: Leaping Leporid
Pet.Description: Left to their own devices, these leporids will leap high into the air at the slightest provocation. Sometimes they'll even come down properly, as well.

Pet.Name: Archetype of Vigilance
Pet.Description: Two parts fortress, one part eyestalks, one part slime.

Pet.Name: Viperid Menace
Pet.Description: Where some viperids lie in wait for their prey, this variety stalks their intended meals for hours.

Pet.Name: Microlicid
Pet.Description: Since synthesized creatures come into being fully grown, why would anyone design an immature helicid?

Pet.Name: Jeweled Onyx Whelpling
Pet.Description: The master jewelcrafters of the Dragon Isles have perfected their craft so much that their gemmed statues can be brought to life. This whelp forged of obsidian is now not to be trifled with.

Pet.Name: Shaggy
Pet.Description: This little rabbit is cute from the tip of her button nose to the tips of her deadly claws.

Pet.Name: Wakyn
Pet.Description: Hope, like this phoenix, rises from the ashes of shattered dreams.

Pet.Name: Azure Frillfish
Pet.Description: Oddly enough, you met this fish drifting through the air.

Pet.Name: Jean's Lucky Fish
Pet.Description: Jean's Lucky Fish was the pick of the yard when he went to go get a new pet. The swift and clean way he reached into the pond to grab hold of the fish and put it into a magic bubble became known as the Pick Yard maneuver.

Pet.Name: Alvin the Anvil
Pet.Description: When Alvin said he wanted to be the best anvil ever, everyone doubted him. If anvils could laugh, he'd be the one laughing now.

Pet.Name: Chestnut
Pet.Description: Chestnut once found an acorn larger than he was, ate the whole thing, and doubled in size. It's a good thing he didn't eat a Trunkalumpf.

Pet.Name: Pistachio
Pet.Description: Pistachio got her name in exactly the way you would expect.

Pet.Name: Shyfly
Pet.Description: These elusive creatures are famous for being hard to find unless you already know where to look. Fortunately, Haniko told you where to look.

Pet.Name: Luvvy
Pet.Description: In its big eyes you can see your own reflection. You also see everything else because its eyes are so big.

Pet.Name: Ghostflame
Pet.Description: A dream of the memory of fire.

Pet.Name: Echo of the Inferno
Pet.Description: A spark can become an ember. An ember can become a raging fire. This creature was never a spark or an ember, it has only ever been a raging fire.

Pet.Name: Bunbo
Pet.Description: It sits anywhere it wants to, but it prefers to sit on laps.

Pet.Name: Scruffles
Pet.Description: Scruffles' lust for battle runs deep.

Pet.Name: Phoenix Wishwing
Pet.Description: Some think this creature is smoldering because it is on fire. In truth it's because of its burning gaze.

Pet.Name: Ashenwing
Pet.Description: Red for the fires in which it was born.

Pet.Name: Echo of the Depths
Pet.Description: What the deep claims, none can reclaim.

Pet.Name: Pilot
Pet.Description: Still learning how to fly.

Pet.Name: Mallard Duckling
Pet.Description: What do you feed a cute little duckling? What? No, not cheese and quackers! Quackers aren't healthy for ducks.

Pet.Name: Quack-E
Pet.Description: Beep. Beep. Beep. Quack.

Pet.Name: Viridescent Duck
Pet.Description: These beautiful, elusive birds have very erratic migratory patterns, which can be difficult to track, leading some explorers to erroneously believe ducks simply didn't exist.

Pet.Name: Echo of the Heights
Pet.Description: In the mountain air, frost lingers upon the grass as a storm rolls in.

Pet.Name: Yipper
Pet.Description: Soon after you put down this slyvern's decay-twisted mother, you learned the hard way both how it got its name and why Zon'Wogi asked you to care for it.

Pet.Name: Blackfeather Nester
Pet.Description: There is no fury quite like that of a mother Blackfeather defending her nest.

Pet.Name: Brightfeather
Pet.Description: It has bright feathers. What else is there to say?

Pet.Name: Buckie
Pet.Description: Gnawing at the roots of magic trees have given this creature the ability to transcend time itself.

Pet.Name: Emmah
Pet.Description: Is it normal for a fish to have fangs?

Pet.Name: Patos
Pet.Description: This frillfish is a no-frills kind of frillfish.

Pet.Name: Berylmane
Pet.Description: The vorquin of the dragon isles have manes that come in a variety of stunning colors.

Pet.Name: Kobaldt
Pet.Description: Sharp crystal needles protrude from this creature's back, and yet it still wants you to pet it somehow.

Pet.Name: Jeweled Sapphire Whelpling
Pet.Description: Sometimes you can see blue light flickering deep inside the gems that make up this strange creature.

Pet.Name: Jeweled Amber Whelpling
Pet.Description: The hardest part to shape was the whelpling's cute little snout.

Pet.Name: Jeweled Ruby Whelpling
Pet.Description: Trade Prince Gallywix wants you to know that he already owns three of these.

Pet.Name: Jeweled Emerald Whelpling
Pet.Description: A magically infused emerald sits at the heart of this creature.

Pet.Name: Primal Stormling
Pet.Description: Raindrops whip around this creature with frightening speed, ripping and tearing anything that touches it. Experts say the best way to avoid injury is to give it a treat and some snuggles.

Pet.Name: Echo of the Cave
Pet.Description: Formed by the reckless use of elemental magic, the slumbering earth awakens. It is angry.

Pet.Name: Snowclaw Cub
Pet.Description: An adult Snowclaw can rattle the very trees with its roar. A cub can rattle one of the smaller branches.

Pet.Name: Bugbiter Tortoise
Pet.Description: This turtle eats bugs, as you'd expect from its name, but you wouldn't believe how large the bugs are.

Pet.Name: Roseate Hopper
Pet.Description: Most brightly colored frogs are incredibly poisonous. The Roseate Hoppers are different because they are only credibly poisonous.

Pet.Name: Chip
Pet.Description: Born of living stone. Reforged by the hands of Wrathion's agents. Sadly much too tiny to make a difference in the black dragons' war against the djaradin.

Pet.Name: Stormie
Pet.Description: As an egg, this proto-drake was struck by a freak bolt of lightning. Years later, the lightning still lives inside.

Pet.Name: Sophic Amalgamation
Pet.Description: A small fraction of the titans' power, an even smaller fraction of their size.

Pet.Name: Scout
Pet.Description: Scout came to the Dragon Isles for adventure and excitement. After finding you, he got both.

Pet.Name: Petal
Pet.Description: When the Bushbeard clan decided they were going to have a wedding, they chose Petal to be the flower girl. She was spectacular.

Pet.Name: Tide Spirit
Pet.Description: I wish that I could bind the tides and bend them to my will. But in its depths the sea abides and waits for no one still.

Pet.Name: Dust Spirit
Pet.Description: When it was captured and bound to a cage made of enchanted metal, this spirit managed to twist and reshape the metal into the suit of armor it now wears.

Pet.Name: Blaze Spirit
Pet.Description: This is the soul of a forest fire. Though its armor keeps its flames under control, you sometimes notice it gazing longingly at dead trees and dry underbrush.

Pet.Name: Gale Spirit
Pet.Description: When it was the wind, this spirit carried scents to every corner of Azeroth. Sometimes you can still smell on it the barest hint of food, smoke, or the carnage of battle.

Pet.Name: Troubled Tome
Pet.Description: Do you dare to open this book of draconic secrets?

Pet.Name: Pinkie
Pet.Description: With her distinctive coloration and impeccable work ethic, Pinkie has propelled herself to the top of the tallstrider fashion world.

Pet.Name: Gilded Mechafrog
Pet.Description: An old and dangerous discarded toy.

Pet.Name: Blaise
Pet.Description: Like a campfire, but it wants skritches.

Pet.Name: Ambre
Pet.Description: Nothing sparked joy in Ambre's heart until it found the perfect match.

Pet.Name: Lord Stantley
Pet.Description: Lord Stantley will arrive fashionably early to any party that serves shrimp.

Pet.Name: Devourer Lobstrok
Pet.Description: Fortunately it mainly devours pet treats.

Pet.Name: Miloh
Pet.Description: Miloh likes naps. Also snacks.

Pet.Name: Brul
Pet.Description: Sure it's just a rock, but how much can it lift?

Pet.Name: Diamondshell
Pet.Description: These snails are especially prized by many drogbar snail-racers for being fast and looking fantastic.

Pet.Name: Thimblerig
Pet.Description: Known to hide money in its shell.

Pet.Name: Ridged Shalewing
Pet.Description: For a creature made of rocks it hovers quite effortlessly.

Pet.Name: Skaarn
Pet.Description: Skaarn likes to coil up inside of your backpack.

Pet.Name: Aquapo
Pet.Description: The fury of the sea in the packge of a puddle.

Pet.Name: Teardrop Moth
Pet.Description: Contrary to their name, these moths are actually quite happy.

Pet.Name: Briarhorn Hatchling
Pet.Description: Loves: Broccoli, playing, and smashing things. Hates: Meat, sleeping, and mean Titan Keepers who won't let you smash things.

Pet.Name: Gill'dan
Pet.Description: Gill'dan earned his great power by drinking the blood of a demon, which would also have turned his scales green had they not already been that color.

Pet.Name: Jeepers
Pet.Description: This eye has witnessed untold horrors, and these fangs may be responsible for a few of their own.

Pet.Name: Doomrubble
Pet.Description: He seems to be very angry, but it's possible he's just hungry.

Pet.Name: Killbot 9000
Pet.Description: DEFECTIVE; REFUSES TO KILL. MARK FOR IMMEDIATE DESTRUCTION OR SALE TO LESS INTELLIGENT ENTITY.

Pet.Name: Obsidian Warwhelp
Pet.Description: A war-obsessed world turned her into a weapon... but they couldn't break her spirit.

Pet.Name: N'Ruby
Pet.Description: A lifetime of servitude to Anub'arak, then the Lich King, and now... you!

Pet.Name: Tobias
Pet.Description: With a nose for secrets, Tobias is ready to be by the side of super sleuths.

Pet.Name: Crimson Swoglet
Pet.Description: Crimson swoglets are considered the most scholarly of all swoglets because they're well red.

Pet.Name: Cheddar
Pet.Description: It got its name because its favorite food is fondue.

Pet.Name: Rithro
Pet.Description: While napping in shrubbery, sometimes his snaggletooth gets caught on a leaf.

Pet.Name: Heartseeker Moth
Pet.Description: Whereas some moths are attracted to light, this particular moth seems attracted to warm, fuzzy feelings. Some say the phrase "butterflies in your stomach" actually refers to an infestation of Heartseeker Moths.

Pet.Name: Reverie
Pet.Description: The duck of your dreams... or perhaps someone else's dreams.

Pet.Name: Dreamborne Scarab
Pet.Description: Compared to a fully grown dreamborne scarab, this is the lesser of two weevils.

Pet.Name: Dreamhoof
Pet.Description: Be sure to sleep with some grass under your pillow so you can give this critter a snack while you dream.

Pet.Name: Memorie
Pet.Description: It is said that some animals dream in black and white. This animal only dreams in green.

Pet.Name: Napps
Pet.Description: This creature could sleep through another Cataclysm.

Pet.Name: Snoozles
Pet.Description: Snoozles was once given a choice between life in the timeless beautiful snowfields and life in a warm home with pet treats. We know which one he chose.

Pet.Name: Seedle
Pet.Description: Seedles burrow beneath plants in the emerald dreams and nibble at their roots.

Pet.Name: Dustite
Pet.Description: Dustites scavenge among the roots of great trees for any small leavings they can find.

Pet.Name: Somnolet
Pet.Description: Dream on. Dream until your dream comes true!

Pet.Name: Snoots
Pet.Description: Snoots has a supernatural sense of smell. It's not any better than normal, it's just supernatural.

Pet.Name: Elmer
Pet.Description: Elmer once ate a whole cake all by himself. It wasn't even his cake.

Pet.Name: Spruce
Pet.Description: What Spruce lacks in speed, she makes up for with sheer stubbornness.

Pet.Name: Juniper
Pet.Description: Juniper's unique coloration makes it hard to hide from predators in the Emerald Dream's lush green foliage. She therefore made the wise decision to travel with you instead.

Pet.Name: Drowsey
Pet.Description: Is it a snail? Is it a dream? Is it the dream of a sleeping snail?

Pet.Name: Snorr
Pet.Description: Wyvern whelps are sleepy by nature. The dreams of wyvern whelps are doubly so.
